title: Head of Projects
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead / Senior Manager – Projects

**Department:** Projects  
**Designation:** Head / Senior Manager – Projects  
**Industry:** Mechanical / Engineering / EPC Projects  
**Reporting To:** Director / Managing Director / Business Head  
**Location:** Head Office / Project Sites

1\. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete lifecycle of mechanical EPC projects from project award through engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning and final handover, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality, safety and customer satisfaction.

The position will provide strategic and operational leadership to project teams and ensure effective coordination between Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Construction, QA/QC, HSE, Finance, HR and client/consultant teams.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take overall responsibility for successful execution of assigned mechanical EPC projects.
* Review project scope, contract conditions, specifications, drawings, BOQ, timelines and deliverables.
* Develop and implement detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Establish project milestones, manpower requirements, resource plans and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedule and take corrective actions for delays.
* Ensure effective mobilisation and deployment of manpower, equipment, materials and other resources.
* Drive timely completion of engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.

B. Project Management \& Control

* Monitor project cost, budget, cash flow, productivity and profitability.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and contractual timelines.
* Review project MIS, DPR/WPR/MPR, progress reports and management dashboards.
* Track planned vs. actual progress, productivity, manpower utilisation and project costs.
* Identify deviations and initiate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal teams and clients.

C. EPC \& Contract Management

* Review and understand EPC contracts, work orders, scope of work, technical specifications and commercial terms.
* Ensure contractual obligations are clearly communicated to the project team.
* Identify variations, additional works, claims and potential commercial risks.
* Coordinate with the commercial/contracts team for submission and recovery of variation claims.
* Manage client/consultant communications relating to scope, schedule, resources, variations and project issues.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for contractual and commercial matters.

D. Engineering \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with Engineering teams for timely release of drawings, technical documents and specifications.
* Review constructability and ensure engineering deliverables are aligned with site requirements.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with clients, consultants and vendors.
* Ensure proper integration between mechanical, piping, structural, electrical and instrumentation activities wherever applicable.
* Support technical resolution of site execution issues.

E. Procurement \& Material Management

* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of project materials.
* Monitor procurement schedules against project requirements.
* Review critical material and equipment procurement status.
* Ensure proper coordination with suppliers, subcontractors and vendors.
* Minimise project delays arising from material shortages and procurement issues.

F. Construction \& Site Management

* Provide leadership to project/site managers and construction teams.
* Ensure efficient execution of fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Monitor manpower productivity and equipment utilisation.
* Drive productivity improvement and minimise idle manpower and equipment costs.
* Ensure proper coordination between various site functions and subcontractors.
* Conduct regular site visits and project performance reviews.

G. Quality \& HSE

* Ensure strict compliance with approved QA/QC procedures, ITPs, inspection requirements and project specifications.
* Ensure adherence to company and client HSE standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
* Review quality and safety performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure project documentation and final handover dossiers are completed as per contractual requirements.

H. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor and develop Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Managers and other project personnel.
* Define responsibilities, targets and KPIs for project teams.
* Assess manpower requirements and coordinate with HR for recruitment and deployment.
* Build a high\-performance project management team.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide guidance for capability development.

I. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Act as the senior point of contact for major project\-related matters.
* Participate in project kick\-off meetings, progress reviews and senior management discussions.
* Resolve escalated project issues in coordination with the client and internal management.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and successful project closure.

J. Project Closure

* Ensure completion of punch points, testing, commissioning and final handover.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test certificates and completion dossiers.
* Ensure commercial closure, reconciliation and final billing are completed.
* Conduct project close\-out reviews and document lessons learned.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within approved schedule.
* Project profitability and cost control.
* Planned vs. actual project progress.
* Manpower productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in project delays and idle manpower costs.
* Material availability and procurement performance.
* Quality performance and reduction in rework.
* Safety performance and accident prevention.
* Timely billing and cash\-flow realisation.
* Variation/claim identification and recovery.
* Client satisfaction.
* Successful project handover and closure.

4\. Qualification

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **PMP / Project Management certification is mandatory or highly preferred.**
* Additional certification in Project Management, Construction Management or Contract Management will be an advantage.

5\. Experience

* **15–20\+ years of relevant experience** in mechanical project execution, preferably in EPC / Engineering / Construction organisations.
* Proven experience in handling **large\-scale mechanical EPC projects** from project initiation to completion.
* Experience in managing multidisciplinary project teams and multiple projects/sites.
* Strong exposure to engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning.
* Experience in project planning, cost control, contracts, client management and commercial coordination.
* Experience in handling project teams, subcontractors, vendors and consultants.

6\. Desired Industry Exposure

Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical / Refinery
* Chemical / Process Plants
* Semiconductor / Advanced Manufacturing
* Power / Utilities
* Piping \& Mechanical EPC
* Industrial Projects
* Structural \& Mechanical Projects
* Fabrication, Erection \& Commissioning

7\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong project planning and execution capability.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Strong knowledge of EPC project methodologies.
* Good understanding of project contracts and commercial aspects.
* Strong cost and schedule management skills.
* Knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project and project management tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Strong client and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet critical project deadlines.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites across India.

8\. Personal Attributes

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Result\-oriented approach.
* Strategic and analytical thinking.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.
* Strong decision\-making capability.
* Ability to lead teams independently.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project issues.
* Customer\-focused mindset.

9\. Role Expectations

The incumbent is expected to function as the **overall project leader**, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, within the approved budget and schedule, in accordance with technical and quality requirements, while maintaining profitability and customer satisfaction.

The position will also contribute to strengthening the organisation's project management systems, standardising project execution practices, improving productivity and developing a strong project management team.

title: Field Recruiter
description:
About the Position

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

If you are confident speaking with people, enjoy networking, and are motivated by targets, this could be a good opportunity to build your career with HyreSpot.

Key Responsibilities

\* Identify and attract suitable candidates through field visits, referrals, online platforms, educational institutions, training centres, and local professional networks.

\* Meet candidates personally to understand their qualifications, experience, career interests, availability, and preferred job opportunities.

\* Conduct preliminary screening and shortlist candidates based on the requirements provided by the recruitment team.

\* Organize and participate in walk\-in interviews, recruitment campaigns, hiring drives, job fairs, and other talent acquisition activities.

\* Coordinate candidate interviews with the internal recruitment team and ensure candidates receive timely information about the process.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with shortlisted candidates and support them through documentation, selection, and joining.

\* Develop candidate networks within the assigned territory and continuously identify new sources for quality applicants.

\* Establish professional relationships with colleges, training institutes, placement centres, local organizations, and other talent pools.

\* Introduce candidates to HyreSpot's career opportunities and communicate job information clearly and professionally.

\* Assist the HR team in local employer\-branding and candidate\-engagement activities.

\* Monitor recruitment activity within the assigned area and identify effective methods for attracting candidates.

\* Share candidate feedback and local market information, including availability of talent and hiring trends, with the HR team.

\* Maintain accurate candidate details and ensure recruitment records are updated on time.

\* Submit daily and weekly activity reports covering sourcing, calls, meetings, interviews, selections, and joining status.

\* Work towards assigned recruitment targets and contribute to the team's overall hiring performance.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

\* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in recruitment or HR.

\* Candidates with up to 3 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.

\* Professionals from field sales, business development, customer service, telecalling, or other people\-oriented roles who want to move into recruitment.

Candidates with strong local networks and excellent communication skills.

A degree in any discipline is acceptable. An HR, Business Administration, or related qualification will be an added advantage.

What We Are Looking For

Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Confidence in approaching and speaking with new people.

Strong networking and relationship\-building ability.

Good follow\-up discipline.

A result\-oriented approach towards assigned targets.

Ability to manage recruitment activities independently.

Comfortable travelling within the assigned territory.

Basic knowledge of computers, email, spreadsheets, and online recruitment platforms.

Knowledge of the local language will be an advantage.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Experience That Will Help

Prior exposure to any of the following will be useful:

However, freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to work in the field are encouraged to apply.

Compensation \& Benefits

Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹24,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Additional Benefits:

Performance\-based recruitment incentives.

Travel allowance/reimbursement as per company policy.

Recruitment and talent acquisition training.

Practical exposure to multiple hiring channels.

Opportunity to develop a strong professional network.

Career progression opportunities within HR and Talent Acquisition.

Recognition for achieving recruitment and joining targets.

Career Opportunity

This role can provide a strong starting point for candidates who want to develop a long\-term career in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Staffing, or Business Development.

High\-performing employees may be considered for increased responsibilities and future career progression within the organization based on performance, consistency, and business requirements.

Apply Now

Join us and become part of a growing recruitment team focused on connecting candidates with meaningful career opportunities.

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021, its ornamental gardens, tumbling fountains and stately Indo\-Saracenic architecture describing a love story between India and the West. Set on a 21\-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna, this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.


Just 20 minutes from the airport, Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride, guided by migratory birds. Discover 137 rooms and suites, 10 dining experiences, two pools, wellness rituals, and the timeless care of the Raffles Butler.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Learning \& Development Manager to join our team in Udaipur, India. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster employee growth. Reporting to the Director of People \& Culture, you will collaborate with leadership teams across the organization to create a culture of continuous learning and professional development. This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative and empathetic professional to make a meaningful impact on our workforce's skills, engagement, and career progression.

* Design, develop, and facilitate a variety of training programs including onboarding, leadership development, skills enhancement, and specialized workshops to support organizational goals and employee development
* Execute a comprehensive onboarding experience for new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and strong foundation for success; continuously update and improve onboarding processes based on feedback and organizational needs
* Conduct thorough needs assessments in collaboration with department leaders to identify skill gaps and training requirements; translate findings into actionable learning strategies
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all training activities, participant information, and completion rates; analyze training data and metrics to measure program effectiveness and ROI
* Support the development and coaching of departmental trainers, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all training initiatives throughout the organization
* Oversee the administration of online learning management systems, including course assignments, progress monitoring, and completion tracking for mandatory and elective programs
* Partner with operational leaders to review job task checklists and training tools, ensuring they support effective departmental onboarding and skill development
* Collaborate with regional Learning \& Development counterparts to align strategic direction, share best practices, and maintain consistency across the organization
* Support apprenticeship programs and educational assistance initiatives, fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional growth
* Oversee the performance review program to ensure timely and thorough completion of probationary and annual reviews for all employees
* Contribute to broader People \& Culture operations and organizational initiatives as assigned; demonstrate flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business needs

  

**Qualifications**  

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a leadership role, preferably within the hospitality, service, or corporate environment
* Proven experience in designing and facilitating training programs that drive measurable results and service excellence
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting needs assessments and translating organizational requirements into effective learning solutions
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Publisher, Excel, and Word)
* Proficiency with online learning management systems and training administration platforms
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop data\-driven improvement strategies
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to diverse audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships with colleagues at all organizational levels


\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Previous experience in Learning \& Development, talent management, or human resources functions
* University degree in Hotel/Restaurant Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
* Experience with budget management and financial planning for training programs
* Familiarity with change management practices and organizational development
* Coaching and mentoring experience
* Experience developing and delivering leadership development programs


\*\*Key Competencies:\*\*

* Enthusiastic, positive, and motivational approach to employee development
* Detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and quality
* Innovative and creative mindset with willingness to explore new training methodologies
* Collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams
* Flexible and adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Results\-oriented with a commitment to achieving organizational goals
* Empathetic and supportive in fostering employee growth and engagement
* Inclusive mindset that values diverse perspectives and backgrounds
* Efficient and organized in managing time and resources effectively
* Visionary thinking with the ability to anticipate future organizational learning needs

  

**Additional Information**  

* An opportunity to be with world’s preferred hospitality company
* Captivating and rewarding experience working alongside passionate professionals
* Range of exclusive Heartist Benefits
* Develop your talent through learning programs by Academy Accor.

description:
Job Description

The Head – HR \& Administration will be responsible for leading the organisation's **human resources strategy and administrative operations**, ensuring alignment with business goals. This role requires a senior HR professional with strong expertise in **HR operations, compliance, talent management, and administration**, preferably within the real estate or construction sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Human Resources Leadership**
* Design and implement HR strategies aligned with organizational growth plans.
* Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning \& development, and employee engagement.

* Act as a strategic HR partner to senior management and department heads.

* Build strong recruitment pipelines for engineering, sales, finance, and support functions.
* Manage external consultants and vendors for staffing needs.

* Conduct periodic salary benchmarking and support annual appraisal cycles.
* **Administration \& Facilities**
* Head all administrative functions including office management, facilities, transport, security, and vendor management.
* Ensure smooth functioning of corporate and site offices.
* Manage administrative budgets and optimize operational costs.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in **Human Resources** or equivalent qualification.
* **12–18\+ years** of progressive HR experience, with at least **5 years in a leadership role**.
* Strong exposure to **real estate, construction, or infrastructure sectors** preferred.
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR compliance.
* Proven ability to work closely with promoters and senior leadership.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strategic HR Leadership
* Strong Employee Relations \& Compliance Expertise
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Management
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving skills
* High integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism
* Ability to manage both **HR and administrative operations**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stable and engaged workforce
* Strong compliance and risk management
* Efficient HR processes and administrative systems
* Positive organizational culture supporting business growth

title: Valuation Analyst
description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.
* Prepare detailed and professional valuation reports with photographs and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

The role may involve both office\-based valuation analysis and field inspections. The Valuator may be required to travel to client premises, workshops, dealerships, warehouses, construction sites, auction yards, and industrial facilities.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Fresher \-Experience

Reporting To

Valuation Manager / Head of Valuation

Contact\- 8144303866

Pay: ₹12,500\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bhadrakh, Odisha 756100

SYSGENIK is a technology consulting and solutions company providing services across CRM, cloud, AI, automation, software development, and digital transformation.

Our technology focus includes Salesforce, Zoho, AI\-enabled solutions, business automation, system integration, and custom application development.

We are hiring an **Inside Sales Executive – Intern / Fresher** to support our business development team with outbound prospecting, lead generation, lead qualification, and meeting generation.

Previous IT sales experience is not mandatory. Training will be provided on our services, sales processes, prospecting methods, and tools.

**Required Skills**

* Confidence speaking with prospective customers over the phone.
* Comfortable with outbound calling and cold outreach.
* Good listening and questioning skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally through email and LinkedIn.
* Basic understanding of sales, lead generation, or business development.
* Ability to research companies and identify relevant decision\-makers.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate prospect and CRM records.
* Comfortable working with sales targets and measurable activities.
* Ability to learn new technology concepts and business solutions.
* Self\-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote environment.

* CRM systems
* Salesforce
* Zoho CRM
* LinkedIn
* Microsoft Office
* Google Workspace
* Lead generation or prospecting platforms
* Sales intelligence tools

Training will be provided for the tools and processes used by SYSGENIK.

Fresh graduates and final\-year students may apply.

Preferred qualifications include:

* BBA
* B.Com
* MBA
* BCA
* B.Tech / BE
* B.Sc.
* Marketing
* Business Administration
* Sales
* Information Technology
* Computer Science

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they have strong communication skills and an interest in B2B technology sales.

**Who Can Apply**

This opportunity is suitable for:

* Fresh graduates
* Final\-year students
* Candidates looking for an internship
* Candidates starting their career in sales
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in inside sales, business development, lead generation, telecalling, customer service, or a related role

Experience with IT services, Salesforce, Zoho, SaaS, CRM, cloud, or software sales is an advantage but is **not required**.

**What You Will Learn**

You will gain practical exposure to:

* B2B technology sales
* Inside sales
* Lead generation
* Cold calling
* Email outreach
* LinkedIn prospecting
* Account research
* Lead qualification
* CRM management
* Sales pipeline management
* Discovery meeting preparation
* Salesforce and Zoho services
* AI and automation solutions
* Cloud and software development services
* Professional communication with international prospects

* Quiet and professional environment for calls and online meetings.
* Ability to attend online training and team meetings.
* Willingness to make outbound calls as part of the regular role.
* Ability to work according to the assigned business schedule.

Depending on the market being targeted, the role may require reasonable alignment with international business hours.

**Career Growth**

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance and sales capability may progress into roles such as:

* Inside Sales Representative
* Business Development Representative
* Business Development Executive
* Senior Business Development Executive

Career progression will depend on performance, demonstrated capability, and business requirements.

title: Robotics Trainer
description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Teaching

* Conduct Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, IoT, and STEM classes for students.
* Deliver engaging practical sessions using robotics kits, microcontrollers, and sensors.
* Explain technical concepts in a student\-friendly manner.
* Develop lesson plans and training materials aligned with school requirements.

Project Development

* Guide students in building robotics and STEM projects.
* Mentor students for science exhibitions, competitions, and innovation challenges.
* Support students in project design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Encourage creativity, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

STEM Lab Management

* Maintain robotics kits, tools, components, and laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper inventory management of STEM lab materials.
* Report damaged or missing equipment and coordinate replacements.
* Maintain safety standards within the laboratory.

Technical Support

* Assist students in coding using Arduino, Scratch, Python, and other relevant platforms.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues during training sessions.
* Support installation and configuration of robotics hardware and software.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain attendance and training records.
* Prepare progress reports for students and schools.
* Document student projects and achievements.
* Capture photos and videos of activities for reporting and promotional purposes.

Competition \& Event Coordination

* Train students for robotics competitions and hackathons.
* Organize STEM workshops, innovation camps, and demonstrations.
* Support school\-level and inter\-school robotics events.

Continuous Learning

* Stay updated with emerging technologies in Robotics, AI, IoT, and STEM education.
* Participate in internal training and skill development programs.

Required Qualifications

title: HR Technology & Automation Manager
description:
**Main Purpose**


The HR Technology \& Automation Manager is responsible for leading the global HR technology function, encompassing the strategic ownership, configuration, governance, continuous improvement, and roadmap evolution of Workday and the broader HR technology landscape. The role also drives HR process automation and digitalization across the organization — identifying, redesigning, and implementing automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enhance the employee experience.


Acting as both a strategic and technical leader, this role bridges HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors. It manages day\-to\-day HRIS operations, leads a team of HRIS analysts, and champions the adoption of workflow automation, AI, and digital tools across HR processes.

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

**HR Technology \& Workday**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday and all HRIS functionalities across the organization, including modules, integrations, security, reporting, and enhancements.
* Manage the full lifecycle of HRIS projects: requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support for implementations, upgrades, and system integrations.
* Develop, maintain, and migrate integration solutions between Workday and internal/external systems (Payroll, Finance, Benefits, etc.) using Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP Web Services, XML, and XSLT.
* Define and enforce HRIS governance frameworks, data standards, access controls, and security configurations to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements to optimize the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of HR systems.
* Manage the HRIS budget including planning, vendor cost management, and tracking execution against approved budgets aligned with business priorities.
* Stay current on Workday releases, community updates, and the broader HR technology market; assess the impact of new features and lead their adoption where relevant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all HRIS configurations, integrations, and processes.
* Provide expert guidance and training to team members and HR stakeholders on HRIS and Workday best practices.
* Serve as the key integrator between functional HR requirements and technical HRIS delivery; partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, and external vendors globally.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies related to HR data security and privacy.

**HR Automation \& Process Digitalization**

* Own the HR automation agenda: systematically identify repetitive, manual, high\-volume, or error\-prone HR processes across the function as candidates for automation or digitalization.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to map, redesign, and streamline processes before automating — ensuring automation reinforces best\-practice workflows, not inefficient ones.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automation solutions including workflow automation tools, RPA, AI\-powered capabilities, system integrations, and digital self\-service enhancements.
* Leverage AI and intelligent automation tools where appropriate to improve HR data quality, accelerate processing, reduce manual intervention, and enable predictive insights.
* Establish governance standards, prioritization frameworks, and documentation practices for all HR automation initiatives across the organization.
* Define and track impact metrics for automation efforts: efficiency gains, reduction in manual effort, data quality improvements, error reduction, and enhanced employee and manager experience.
* Act as the bridge between HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors to ensure alignment on automation strategy, tooling, data security, and architecture.
* Build awareness and capability across the HR team for automated tools and self\-service solutions, driving adoption and reducing dependency on manual processing.
* Continuously scan the HR technology landscape for emerging platforms, AI\-enabled capabilities, and automation tools that can advance HR digitalization goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field of study.
* Minimum 8 years of HRIS/HR technology experience, with at least 5 years of hands\-on Workday expertise including module configuration, integrations, and security (Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP, XML, XSLT).
* Proven track record leading HRIS teams and delivering global HR technology initiatives in a complex, multi\-country environment.
* Demonstrated experience in HR automation, process digitalization, or the implementation of workflow/RPA/AI\-enabled solutions within HR.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and data across domains such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, and Learning.
* Experience with Workday tenant security configuration, integration architecture design patterns, and ERP integration best practices.
* Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and organizational skills; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to translate technical topics clearly for non\-technical HR stakeholders and present confidently at senior levels.
* Experience with software development lifecycle and project management; agile methodology experience is a plus.
* Shows initiative, works independently with minimal supervision, and approaches complex problems creatively with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Exposure to AI tools, process mining, intelligent automation platforms, or digital transformation programs is a strong plus.

title: Plant Manager
description:
**PLANT MANAGER**

**Industry:** Thermistors / Electronic Components / Powder Metallurgy  
**Department:** Plant Operations  
**Reports To:** Managing Director / Operations Director  
**Location:** Nila Tech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Experience:** 12–20 years, preferably with 5\+ years in a plant leadership role

Job Purpose

The Plant Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the manufacturing plant, ensuring safe, efficient, cost\-effective, and timely production of thermistors and other powder\-metallurgy\-based electronic components.

The role will lead production, process engineering, quality, maintenance, production planning, stores, utilities, safety, and manpower management while driving continuous improvement, productivity enhancement, waste reduction, and customer satisfaction.

The Plant Manager will be expected to develop a strong manufacturing culture based on process discipline, quality at source, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities1\. Plant Operations \& Production

* Take overall responsibility for day\-to\-day plant operations and manufacturing performance.
* Ensure production plans are achieved in terms of quantity, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Develop and implement production strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Monitor production capacity, bottlenecks, cycle times, OEE, productivity, and utilization.
* Ensure effective control of processes involved in powder metallurgy and thermistor manufacturing, including:
* Raw\-material preparation and powder processing
* Mixing / formulation
* Granulation and pressing
* Sintering / firing
* Grinding and sizing
* Metallization / electrode application
* Lead forming / assembly
* Electrical testing and inspection
* Packaging and final dispatch
* Establish appropriate process parameters, control plans, and standard operating procedures in coordination with engineering and quality teams.
* Improve line balancing, material flow, layout, and production efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and minimize delays and downtime.

2\. Quality Management

* Ensure consistent product quality and compliance with customer specifications.
* Work closely with the Quality team to establish and maintain process controls.
* Drive reduction of rejection, rework, scrap, customer complaints, and process variation.
* Monitor critical characteristics such as resistance values, B\-value, tolerance, dimensional accuracy, electrical characteristics, mechanical strength, and reliability, as applicable to the product.
* Ensure effective root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action for internal and customer quality issues.
* Promote a zero\-defect / quality\-at\-source culture throughout the plant.
* Support customer audits, certification audits, and process/product audits.

3\. Powder Metallurgy \& Process Engineering

* Develop a strong understanding of powder metallurgy processes and their impact on product performance.
* Ensure control of critical variables such as:
* Powder composition and particle characteristics
* Mixing uniformity
* Binder/additive control
* Compaction pressure and density
* Green strength
* Sintering temperature profiles and atmosphere
* Shrinkage and dimensional control
* Electrode/metallization quality
* Electrical characteristics
* Work with R\&D / Process Engineering teams for new product introduction, process development, and process optimization.
* Lead scale\-up activities from laboratory/prototype stage to mass production.
* Ensure process capability and repeatability for critical manufacturing operations.

4\. Maintenance \& Utilities

* Ensure high availability and reliability of production equipment.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance systems.
* Monitor equipment downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance costs.
* Ensure timely maintenance of critical equipment such as presses, furnaces, grinders, mixers, testing equipment, compressors, HVAC systems, and utilities.
* Develop plans for machine upgrades, automation, replacement, and capacity expansion.
* Ensure adequate spare\-parts planning and inventory control.
* Improve equipment OEE and reduce unplanned breakdowns.

5\. Cost \& Productivity Improvement

* Take ownership of plant manufacturing costs and drive continuous cost reduction.
* Identify opportunities to reduce:
* Material consumption
* Scrap and rejection
* Energy consumption
* Labour cost per unit
* Machine downtime
* Consumable costs
* Conversion costs
* Establish productivity improvement targets for each department.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing / Kaizen / Six Sigma initiatives where appropriate.
* Promote automation, semi\-automation, poka\-yoke, and process simplification.
* Improve yield and material utilization across powder\-processing and sintering operations.

6\. Production Planning \& Materials

* Coordinate with Production Planning, Purchase, Stores, and Sales teams to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Maintain optimum levels of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.
* Identify and eliminate material\-flow constraints.
* Ensure FIFO, traceability, batch control, and proper material identification.
* Coordinate capacity planning for new programs and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely completion of production orders and dispatch commitments.

7\. People \& Team Management

* Lead and develop production, quality, maintenance, engineering, and support teams.
* Establish clear KPIs and performance objectives for departmental managers and supervisors.
* Build a culture of accountability, discipline, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Identify training and competency requirements.
* Develop second\-line leadership and succession plans.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and optimum utilization of personnel.
* Maintain strong communication between shop\-floor employees and management.

8\. Safety, Environment \& Compliance

* Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with applicable statutory requirements.
* Implement robust systems for:
* Industrial safety
* Fire prevention and emergency preparedness
* Chemical handling
* Furnace and high\-temperature equipment safety
* Electrical safety
* PPE compliance
* Dust control and housekeeping
* Waste disposal
* Drive accident prevention and near\-miss reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental and statutory regulations.

9\. Continuous Improvement

* Establish a structured continuous\-improvement program across the plant.
* Use data\-driven methods to identify losses and improvement opportunities.
* Drive initiatives focused on:
* OEE improvement
* Yield improvement
* First\-pass yield
* Scrap reduction
* Cycle\-time reduction
* Energy efficiency
* Setup\-time reduction
* Inventory reduction
* Workplace organization / 5S
* Promote problem\-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, SPC, FMEA, and Kaizen.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Plant Manager will be accountable for achieving agreed targets relating to:

* Production achievement (%)
* On\-time delivery (%)
* OEE (%)
* First\-pass yield (%)
* Process yield (%)
* Rejection and scrap (%)
* Customer complaints / PPM
* Manufacturing conversion cost
* Productivity per employee
* Machine downtime
* MTBF / MTTR
* Energy consumption per unit
* Inventory / WIP levels
* Safety incidents
* Employee productivity and turnover
* Continuous\-improvement savings

Education \& ExperienceEssential

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* 12–20 years of relevant manufacturing experience.
* Proven experience managing a manufacturing plant or major production operation.
* Strong experience in production, quality, maintenance, and process improvement.

Preferred

* Experience in powder metallurgy, ceramics, electronic components, thermistors, ferrites, resistors, sensors, or similar precision manufacturing industries.
* Knowledge of sintering/firing processes and material\-property control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, SPC, and structured problem solving.
* Exposure to ISO 9001 and other relevant quality\-management systems.
* Experience in new\-product industrialization and process scale\-up.

Technical Competencies

The candidate should have a good working knowledge of:

* Powder metallurgy manufacturing
* Material and process control
* Sintering / furnace operations
* Pressing and compaction
* Grinding and finishing
* Electrical/electronic component manufacturing
* Process capability and SPC
* Quality management systems
* Preventive/predictive maintenance
* Production planning
* Lean Manufacturing / Kaizen
* Root\-cause analysis
* Cost reduction
* Industrial engineering and productivity improvement
* ERP/MRP systems
* Health, safety, and environmental requirements

Leadership Competencies

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work under production and customer\-delivery pressures
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Data\-driven approach to decision\-making
* Change\-management capability
* Strong shop\-floor orientation
* Ability to develop people and future leaders

Key Interfaces

The Plant Manager will work closely with:

* Managing Director / CEO
* Sales \& Marketing
* R\&D / Product Development
* Process Engineering
* Quality Assurance
* Production Planning
* Purchase \& Supply Chain
* Maintenance \& Utilities
* Finance
* HR \& Administration
* Customers and external auditors

Overall Success Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on manufacturing leader capable of managing a technically demanding plant while simultaneously improving quality, productivity, yield, delivery, cost, and safety.

The person should be comfortable working on the shop floor, analyzing process data, solving technical problems, leading cross\-functional teams, and converting business objectives into measurable plant\-level results.

Primary Objective

Build a highly reliable, efficient, scalable, and quality\-driven manufacturing operation capable of consistently producing thermistors and powder\-metallurgy components to stringent customer specifications and delivery requirements.

title: Regional Manager- Supply & Network for RSA Business Unit
description:
**Designation: Regional Manager of Supply \& Network for RSA Business Unit**

**Experience: 5\-10 years Type of Employment: Full Time, Permanent**

**Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore Role Overview**

The Regional Manager – Supply \& Network will own the complete supply network and operational readiness of ReadyAssist within the assigned territory. This is a high\-calibre field leadership role, not a conventional vendor\-management position. The RM will effectively taking complete ownership of network availability, skill coverage, partner activation, order acceptance, fulfilment, quality, cost, and partner discipline. The role requires extensive on\-ground presence, continuous market mapping, aggressive partner onboarding, relationship building, operational problem\-solving, and 24×7 supply management. The ultimate objective is simple: Ensure ReadyAssist has the right service provider, with the right skill, at the right location, at the right time — 24×7, 365 days a year — to fulfil every eligible RSA order within SLA.

The person we are looking for: A hunter, builder and operator who can walk into a market, understand the supply gap, find the right partners, negotiate, onboard, activate them, and build a reliable 24×7 supply network. Someone who does not wait for supply problems to appear on a dashboard — they go to the ground and solve them.

Preferred Experience **5–10 years in Ground Operations, Field Operations, Mobility, Logistics, Last\-Mile Delivery, Aggregator Management, Partner Acquisition, or similar businesses.**  Minimum 3–5 years in a field leadership role managing distributed partner/aggregator networks.

**Proven experience in on\-ground partner acquisition and network expansion.**  Experience managing large and geographically distributed service\-provider ecosystems. **Experience in an on\-demand, SLA\-driven business is strongly preferred.** 

Experience in RSA, automotive, mobility, logistics, last\-mile delivery, e\-commerce, food delivery, or similar businesses will be an advantage. **Strong understanding of dashboards, operational technology, partner platforms, and data\-driven execution.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Territory Ownership **Own the complete RSA supply network within the assigned territory.**  Take end\-to\-end accountability for supply availability and order fulfilment. **Act as the single owner of supply performance for the territory.**  Build the territory into a strong, scalable, and reliable supply network. **Identify market opportunities and supply gaps proactively.**  Take complete ownership of resolving ground\-level supply challenges. 2\. Supply Network Building \& Expansion **Build and continuously expand the network of: o Aggregators o Mechanics o Towing partners o Workshops o Specialized service providers o Other relevant roadside assistance partners**  Identify underserved locations, cities, towns, highways, and pin codes.

Develop supply before business demand increases. **Maintain adequate primary and backup supply across critical locations.**  Build additional capacity for nights, weekends, holidays, peak periods, and emergencies.

3\. **Aggregator \& Partner Acquisition Personally drive partner acquisition and onboarding across the territory.**  Spend significant time in the market identifying and engaging potential aggregators and service providers. **Build strong local networks and market intelligence.**  Conduct partner meetings, capability assessments, negotiations, onboarding, and activation. **Continuously maintain a strong pipeline of prospective partners.**  Acquire the right quality and quantity of supply rather than simply increasing partner count. **Ensure every onboarded partner becomes an active and productive partner.**

4\. 24×7 Supply Availability **Ensure supply is available 24×7, 365 days a year.**  Monitor supply availability by: o Location o Pin code o Time of day o Skill type o Vehicle type o Demand pattern **Identify night\-time and low\-demand\-period supply gaps.**  Build contingency and backup supply for critical locations. **Ensure sufficient supply capacity during sudden demand spikes.**

5\. Order Fulfilment \& SLA **Own 100% order fulfilment for the territory.**  Ensure 100% order acceptance **Monitor: o Order acceptance**

o Response time o Fulfilment o SLA adherence o Cancellations o Declines o Unassigned orders o Escalations **Immediately intervene when supply shortages affect fulfilment.**  Conduct root\-cause analysis for every major supply failure. **Ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained. 6\. Skill Coverage \& Network Capability**  Ensure the territory has adequate coverage across required RSA skills. **Identify gaps in specialized services and build appropriate supply.**  Ensure the right service provider is available for the right job. **Continuously assess whether the existing network can support current and future business requirements.**  Build specialized supply wherever business requirements demand it.

7\. Partner Activation \& Productivity **Ensure onboarded partners remain active, available, and productive.**  Drive partner activation and adoption of ReadyAssist technology. **Improve order acceptance and partner productivity.**  Identify inactive, low\-performing, and unreliable partners. **Take corrective action through engagement, coaching, replacement, or network restructuring.**  Maintain strong partner relationships while enforcing operational discipline.

8\. Partner Quality \& Discipline **Ensure all partners adhere to ReadyAssist SOPs, quality standards, SLA requirements, and customer\-handling expectations.**  Conduct regular partner visits and audits. **Verify actual ground\-level availability rather than relying only on system data.**  Take action against partners demonstrating poor quality, misconduct, repeated SLA breaches, or operational indiscipline. **Maintain a high\-quality and dependable partner ecosystem.**

9\. Cost \& Commercial Discipline **Maintain healthy supply economics within the territory.**  Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising fulfilment or customer experience. **Monitor partner payout and service economics.**  Identify inefficient supply structures and redesign them where required. **Balance availability, quality, fulfilment and cost.**

10\. Extensive Field Execution **Spend a significant majority of time on the ground.**  Travel extensively across the assigned territory. **Conduct regular market visits and partner meetings.**  Personally visit critical supply\-gap locations. **Conduct surprise partner visits and operational audits.**  Meet new aggregators and service providers continuously. **Understand local market dynamics, competitor networks, pricing, availability, and partner behaviour.**  Be willing to travel anytime and anywhere when the business requires it.

11\. Data \& Performance Management **Study daily operational dashboards and identify supply gaps.**  Convert data into specific field actions. **Track territory\-level KPIs and corrective actions.**  Review partner productivity and network health regularly. **Use data to decide: o Where to onboard o Which partners to activate o Where additional supply is required o Which partners need intervention o Where supply needs to be replaced**  Provide regular performance insights to the Zonal Manager – Supply \& Network.

12\. Business Expansion Support **Build supply readiness and new business opportunities.**  Work closely with Business and Operations teams to understand upcoming demand. **Ensure the supply network is ready before business goes live.**  Scale the territory rapidly when business requirements increase.

**Sujani**

As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with the HR team, contribute to high\-impact projects, and gain hands\-on experience in communication, content creation, and digital HR resources while working with colleagues. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. * Creates user guides, training materials, status updates, meeting notes, and process documentation to support adoption and operational excellence.

description:
**Work Schedule**


Other**Environmental Conditions**


Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Various outside weather conditions**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

As a Field Service Supervisor at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support a team of skilled field service engineers while ensuring exceptional service delivery to our customers. This role combines leadership with technical expertise, promoting operational excellence and customer satisfaction. You will coordinate service activities, manage team performance, and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. You'll contribute to meaningful impact by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**Job Designation: Regional Service Manager (M\&M)**

**Role Overview: \-**


The Regional Service Manager is responsible for leading a team of Service team to provide world\-class support for **XRF/OES/Process Analyzer analytical instruments in the assigned region**. This role balances technical problem\-solving with strategic business growth, focusing on service revenue generation, customer satisfaction (CAS), and team development within the Cement, Steel, and Process industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Manage and proactively lead the regional service team through all stages of the client lifecycle—from administration and planning to execution and completion.
* **Revenue Generation:** Drive regional profitability by achieving or exceeding targets for service contracts (AMCs/CMCs) and spare parts sales.
* **Operational Excellence:** Monitor team KPIs, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
* **Customer Allegiance:** Improve Customer Allegiance Scores (CAS) by maintaining strong relationships with existing clients and identifying new business opportunities.
* **Compliance:** Ensure all team activities align with corporate policies, HR compliance, and safety standards.
* **Mentorship:** Lead, coach, and develop FSEs to upgrade their technical skills and prepare them for future leadership roles.
* **Succession Planning:** Identify and groom a successor through a structured development plan in line with organizational growth.
* **Culture:** Foster a high\-performing team environment built on empathy, ownership, and accountability.
* **Domain Expertise:** Strong knowledge of process applications specifically within the **Cement, Steel, and Process industries**.
* **Troubleshooting:** Apply advanced logical and analytical diagnostic skills to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and resolve complex instrument issues.
* **Software Proficiency:** Expert use of Service Management Software and the Microsoft Office suite.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive results through persuasion and partnership.
* **Conflict Management:** Skilled at handling difficult customer situations and critical technical escalations with a "soft\-spoken" yet firm professional demeanor.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to balance immediate technical fixes with long\-term business objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** **10\+ years** of total working experience.
	+ Minimum **5 years** in Customer Service Management.
	+ **2\+ years** in a direct supervisory/leadership role managing technical teams.
* **Technical Hands\-on:** Experience on Analytical instruments and Direct experience with **XRF/OES/Process Analyzers analytical instruments** is additional advantage.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
iCapital is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition team based in the Jaipur office and reporting to the Talent Acquisition International \- Senior Vice President, based in Lisbon. This position will be responsible for delivering on all facets of talent acquisition success throughout the organization. We are looking for someone that will seek to deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience and will be a trusted partner to our stakeholders. You can expect to recruit for roles at all levels, for our India and other APAC locations (Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and Australia).


**Responsibilities**:


* Oversee all talent acquisition logistics, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, interview scheduling, offer decision coordination, and employment documentation.
* Find, engage, and activate passive candidates using alternative search techniques and creative sourcing channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct interviews, and assess candidates against role requirements and organizational fit.
* Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with candidates, ensuring a clear understanding of their expectations, motivations, and concerns.
* Provide a high‑quality candidate experience at every stage of the recruitment process.
* Regularly track and report pipeline activity to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to a cost‑effective talent acquisition strategy through creative job postings, networking, industry engagement, and partnerships with professional organizations.
* Provide input on employer branding initiatives across digital channels, including social media and targeted campaigns.
* Stay up to date on industry trends, innovative sourcing tools, and best practices; recommend new approaches to enhance global talent acquisition processes.
* Partner with HR team members to ensure all new hires receive a seamless and best‑in‑class onboarding experience.
* Support broader HR initiatives and projects, including those related to diversity, candidate experience, employee engagement, and process optimization.
* Support senior recruiting team members with admin tasks \- scheduling interviews, contracts, hiring documentation.

  


**Qualifications**


* Experience in full‑cycle recruitment, preferably in a fast‑paced or international environment and or Financial Services. Knowledge of the FinTech space a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or another business\-related field
* \+6 years full cycle recruiting experience mainly in technology roles.
* Strong sourcing skills, including experience engaging passive talent.
* Excellent communication and relationship‑building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders with professionalism and urgency.
* Familiarity with ATS system – Greenhouse , sourcing tools (Linkedin Recruiter), and social recruiting platforms.
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
* Fluency in the English language – both written and verbal

  



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).

title: Case Mgr, MSK [S], MSK
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contractual role.  

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.  

We are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.  

The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.  

This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.  

Essential Responsibilities:  

* Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
* Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
* Address and respond to sensitive situations
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
* Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Do you have 2\+ years of customer service experience, or a Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field?
* Do you have knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word?
* Do you have a Master's degree or above?
* Do you have experience handling confidential information?

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Analyst - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities**  

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated HR Recruiter to join our Human Resources team. The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, from identifying potential candidates to onboarding new hires. This role requires a proactive approach to sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent to support our business needs and growth objectives.* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand job requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews to assess candidate qualifications and fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs.
* Manage the candidate experience to ensure a positive and professional recruitment process.
* Conduct reference checks and background verifications as needed.
* Assist in developing and updating job descriptions and specifications.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Participate in employer branding initiatives to enhance the company's reputation as an employer of choice.
* Support diversity and inclusion efforts in recruitment practices.


  

**About you** **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a recruiter, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
* Strong understanding of recruitment processes and candidate sourcing techniques.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Familiarity with employment laws and regulations.

**Why Join Us:*** Be part of a global leader in insurance and risk management.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being

HR Shared Services is a critical part of Target’s HR ecosystem, serving as a central hub that brings together people, processes, data, and technology to deliver seamless, consistent, and human\-centric HR support at scale. By centralizing, simplifying, and standardizing key HR operations, enabling self\-service, and driving efficiency through automation and digital tools, HR Shared Services empowers team members with timely, accurate support while enabling HR partners and Centers of Excellence to focus on strategic business impact.


As **Sr MANAGER** – HR Shared Services, Pay, Timekeeping and Scheduling Team, you will enable high performance by fostering a reliability\-centered culture and leading critical HR service delivery operations for Target. You will provide strong leadership by attracting and developing talent, enabling continuous learning, strengthening operational capability, and optimizing team effectiveness.


You will play a key leadership role in advancing a reliable, digital\-first, and team\-member\-centered HR Shared Services model. This role requires a leader who can balance strategic thinking with operational discipline, lead through ambiguity, build strong partnerships across HR and business teams, and develop talent for current and future business needs.


As an HR Shared Services Sr. Manager, you will take the lead as you drive:

**Strategy, Service Delivery and Operational Leadership**

* Lead HR Shared Services teams responsible for pay, timekeeping, scheduling, and relevant HR lifecycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant service delivery.
* Define and execute strategic and operational priorities that strengthen service quality, productivity, risk management, and team member experience.
* Translate enterprise HR priorities into clear team goals, service expectations, operational plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure core HR processes are delivered on time, within expected service levels, and in alignment with defined policies, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Establish and continuously improve operating routines, performance metrics, process controls, escalation paths, and governance mechanisms.
* Use data, case trends, insights, and operational reporting to identify experience gaps, process risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Build strong partnerships with HR leaders, HR COEs, Product, Technology, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver consistent and scalable HR support.
* Lead and support high\-priority initiatives that improve operational efficiency, simplify work, enhance process reliability, and strengthen enterprise HR outcomes.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high\-risk issues, ensuring appropriate judgment, timely resolution, confidentiality, and stakeholder partnership.

**Digital Enablement, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Champion a digital\-first HR Shared Services experience by strengthening self\-service, knowledge content, automation, and AI\-enabled support pathways where appropriate.
* Identify patterns in inquiries, manual work, repeat contacts, escalations, and process breakdowns, and translate these insights into recommendations for content, workflow, automation, or system enhancements.
* Partner with Product, Technology, and HR stakeholders to support testing, rollout, adoption, and stabilization of new tools, workflows, and system improvements.
* Drive digitization and automation opportunities that improve speed, accuracy, consistency, and scalability while maintaining appropriate controls and human judgment.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by applying structured problem\-solving, process discipline, and data\-informed decision making.
* Ensure new and improved processes are clearly documented, effectively communicated, and consistently adopted across the team.

**Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of HR Shared Services leaders and specialists, creating clarity around priorities, performance expectations, service standards, and ways of working.
* Build a high\-performing, inclusive, and resilient team culture grounded in accountability, learning, adaptability, collaboration, and care.
* Develop talent through coaching, feedback, career development, succession planning, and capability\-building experiences.
* Strengthen team capability in HR operations, digital tools, data interpretation, problem solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, and service excellence.
* Plan and structure resources effectively to meet business priorities, service demand, project needs, and operational commitments.
* Foster strong communication rhythms that ensure alignment, transparency, and clear ownership across the team.
* Inspire creative and critical thinking, encouraging the team to challenge the status quo, solve problems, and continuously improve the team member experience.

**About you:**

* 12–15 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll, shared services, service delivery, or related business operations.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience, preferably in HR Shared Services, payroll, high\-volume operations, or digital service environments.
