title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**1\. COMPANY OVERVIEW** 





 Established in 1982, Aster Medicines Pvt Ltd is one of East India's leading pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprises, operating an advanced GMP and ISO 9001:2015 certified production facility situated in the Hajipur Industrial Area, Bihar. The company specializes in large\-scale third\-party contract manufacturing and PCD franchise distribution of critical care injectable formulations—including Ceftriaxone, Meropenem, Piperacillin Tazobactam, and dry powder formulations—alongside oral suspensions and specialized baby care products (Aster Baby Oil). Featuring Class 100 sterile cleanrooms, double\-pass RO \+ EDI Water\-for\-Injection (WFI) generation plants, and automated filling lines with a capacity of over 1 Million vials per month, Aster Medicines is powered by a dedicated team of over 75 skilled professionals committed to global pharmacopoeial quality standards (IP/BP/USP).
 




  





**2\. POSITION SUMMARY \& OBJECTIVE** 





 The HR Executive will serve as the operational cornerstone for human resources management at the Hajipur manufacturing plant and corporate office. The role demands an agile, hands\-on HR generalist capable of driving shop\-floor and technical talent recruitment, administering multi\-shift attendance and payroll inputs, maintaining flawless statutory labor compliance, organizing audit\-ready WHO\-GMP personnel training logs, and fostering constructive industrial relations across a 75\+ strong workforce.
 




  





**3\. KEY ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**A. Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Allocation** 




**·** 
**Plant Manpower Planning:** 

 Partner with Plant Managers and Department Heads to assess shift\-wise manpower requisitions (MRFs) and fill staffing voids promptly.
 




**·** 
**End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 

 Lead hiring cycles for machine operators, visual inspection workers, QA/QC chemists, microbiologists, storekeepers, and administrative personnel.
 




**·** 
**Sourcing \& Screening:** 

 Utilize online recruitment portals, local employment exchanges, technical polytechnics/ITI networks, and internal referrals for talent sourcing.
 




**·** 
**Selection \& Onboarding:** 

 Coordinate technical interviews, negotiate offers, verify background documentation, and facilitate day\-one joining formalities.
 




**B. Induction \& WHO\-GMP Training Coordination** 




**·** 
**Structured Plant Induction:** 

 Conduct comprehensive orientation for new employees on plant safety, company policies, code of conduct, and hygiene regulations.
 




**·** 
**GMP \& SOP Training Management:** 

 Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA) and Safety Officers to schedule and document mandatory WHO\-GMP, GLP, and fire\-safety training.
 




**·** 
**Audit Documentation:** 

 Maintain meticulous, up\-to\-date employee training cards, qualification certificates, and competence matrix records for regulatory and customer audits.
 




**C. Statutory Compliances \& Labor Regulations** 




**·** 
**Labor Statute Adherence:** 

 Ensure 100% adherence to the Factories Act, 1948, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, and Bihar State Factory Rules.
 




**·** 
**Portal Filings \& Returns:** 

 Manage monthly calculation, challan generation, and timely online portal submissions for Provident Fund (EPFO), ESIC, and Professional Tax (PT).
 




**·** 
**Statutory Registers Maintenance:** 

 Maintain audit\-ready statutory registers (Muster Roll, Overtime Register, Adult Worker Register, Accident Register, Fines \& Advances Register).
 




**·** 
**Audit Facilitation:** 

 Represent the HR department during labor department inspections, factory inspectorate visits, and third\-party vendor audits.
 




**D. Shift Rostering, Attendance \& Payroll Input Management** 




**·** 
**Biometric Attendance Monitoring:** 

 Administer daily biometric attendance and shift allocations (Morning, Evening, Night, and General shifts) for 150\+ plant personnel.

The **Lead Project Engineer** will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, leading application implementation projects, and providing technical direction throughout the project lifecycle. The role will work closely with business stakeholders, project teams, developers, and other technical professionals to ensure solutions are properly designed, implemented, tested, and delivered.

title: Digital Customer Experience Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
 Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

*The Integrated Components \& Solutions (ICD) division owns Caterpillar’s Wear \& Maintenance (W\&M) components business — the ground engaging tools, undercarriage, hose \& coupling, fluids \& filters, and associated hardware that keep the world’s machines running. Our team is building the digital, data, and AI capabilities that make these products easier for customers and dealers to find, buy, use, and get value from.*
 As Data Specialist, Wear \& Maintenance (W\&M), you will help maintain and automate the W\&M data layer that powers our digital and AI capabilities. Supporting the W\&M Digital Solutions team and the W\&M Customer Experience strategy lead — and partnering closely with data owners and engineering teams — you will help build and run the processes that carry W\&M data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options — keeping it complete, accurate, and automated. This is a hands\-on, technical role: you will develop data pipelines and automation, support data analytics, and track data quality so that every downstream digital and AI experience is built on trusted data.
   

  

 You will play a key role in maintaining and improving these data processes, while also supporting the analytics and quality tracking behind smarter customer and dealer experiences.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Maintain and automate the W\&M data layer, and develop the processes that transform W\&M data from parts information, through compatibility, into service options. You will support data analytics and data\-quality tracking across the teams and systems that make up the W\&M digital ecosystem — from the underlying data, to the AI capabilities that use it, to the customer\- and dealer\-facing channels where it all comes together. You will help build, run, and monitor data pipelines and automation — using approaches such as SQL, Python, and AI\-assisted tooling such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) — that keep W\&M part, compatibility, and service\-option data complete, accurate, and trustworthy.
   

  

 You will be a key contributor to the team that owns W\&M domain data quality — helping close gaps, remediate defects, and improve coverage so W\&M offerings surface reliably across VisionLink, Cat Central, SIS2, and the Cat AI Assistant.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Maintain and automate the W\&M data layer — build and run the processes that carry data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options.
* Write and maintain SQL and Python to transform data, build automation, and validate that data\- and AI\-driven processes return accurate, trustworthy results.
* Support data analytics and quality tracking — monitor coverage, completeness, and accuracy, and surface defects for remediation.
* Contribute to and support our core product and component data — helping close gaps, improve accuracy, and ensure high quality, because good data is the foundation of every digital and AI capability. Use AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate data maintenance, classification, and enrichment at scale, with appropriate human review.
* Serve as a W\&M data domain contributor, ensuring data reflects our business needs and how customers and dealers work.
* Communicate data status, quality metrics, and results clearly to stakeholders across functions and geographies.


**What You Will Have**
* Data Management: Working knowledge of the processes, tools, and techniques of data management; ability to maintain the quality, integrity, and accessibility of organizational data across its lifecycle, and integrate data resources for business processes and functional support.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of data and process problems and create alternative solutions that resolve them.
* Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Solid Understanding of the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision and to monitor and improve the quality of organizational data.
* Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for requirements analysis; ability to elicit, analyze, and document data and process requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
* Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively receive, interpret, and convey data status, quality metrics, and business needs in written and oral communications across many geographies and functional disciplines.


**Considerations For Top Candidates**
* 3\+ years of experience in data management, engineering, or analytics.
* Hands\-on proficiency with SQL and Python for querying, transforming, and automating data workflows.
* Experience with data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL) and comfort turning data into usable, trustworthy results. Ability to build Snowflake database objects (views, tables, stored procedures, etc.).
* General knowledge of Wear \& Maintenance products (ground engaging tools, undercarriage, maintenance parts) is a plus; familiarity with engineering/BOM data is valued.
* Ability to build pipelines that leverage machine learning and/or AI agents to incorporate business logic and ensure data quality and completeness. Interest in and aptitude for AI\-assisted data tooling (e.g., MCP, LLM\-based tools) to accelerate data maintenance and quality.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of improving data quality, coverage, and consistency.

description:

* Monitoring and Alert Handling:
+ Monitor security alerts and events generated by security systems, such as intrusion detection/prevention systems, firewalls, and antivirus solutions.
+ Respond to and investigate alerts to determine if they represent security incidents.

* Incident Triage:
+ Conduct initial triage of security incidents to assess the severity and impact.
+ Classify and prioritize incidents based on established criteria.

* Security Incident Analysis:
+ Analyze security events and incidents to identify patterns, trends, and potential security threats.
+ Collaborate with higher\-level SOC analysts or incident response teams for complex incident analysis.

* Documentation:
+ Maintain detailed records of security incidents, including actions taken, findings, and resolutions.
+ Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for common incidents and responses.

* Communication:
+ Communicate with the IT team to provide updates on security incidents.
+ Escalate incidents to higher\-level SOC analysts or incident response teams as needed.

* Security Tool Management:
+ Use and manage security tools and technologies to monitor and analyze network traffic, logs, and alerts.
+ Ensure the proper functioning of security tools and report any issues for resolution.

* Vulnerability Management:
+ Assist in the identification and management of vulnerabilities within the organization's systems.
+ Report and escalate vulnerabilities to appropriate teams for remediation.

* Security Awareness:
+ Contribute to security awareness programs helping to educate employees about potential threats and best practices.

* Continuous Learning:
+ Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices.
+ Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance skills.

* Compliance Monitoring:
+ Ensure that security activities align with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
+ Assist in the preparation of reports for compliance purposes.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

* Ability to evaluate and onboard new log sources.

Postola is an AI\-powered content creation app that helps users create content quickly and easily using AI.

We are looking for a confident and well\-spoken Part\-Time Telecaller / Sales Executive to join our team.

The main responsibility is simple: you will be provided with leads, speak to them over the phone, explain how Postola works, answer their questions, and convert interested leads into paying customers.

* Demonstrate the basic features and benefits of the app.

* Follow up with interested leads through calls and WhatsApp.
* Build trust and convert interested leads into paying customers.

* Good spoken Hindi and Hinglish communication.
* Basic to good spoken English for handling customers when required.

* Good conversational and persuasion skills.

* Basic smartphone/computer knowledge.
* Willingness to learn a simple AI product.
* Previous telecalling, customer support or sales experience is an advantage, but freshers with good communication skills are welcome.

* Job Type: Part\-Time
* Work Mode: Work From Home
* Working Hours: Approximately 4 hours per day
* Working Days: 6 days per week
* Salary: ₹10,000 per month

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for someone who is friendly, confident, patient and good at talking to people.

Most customer conversations will be in Hindi/Hinglish, but the candidate should also be comfortable with basic English when required.

The ideal candidate should be able to understand Postola quickly, explain it to customers in very simple language, build confidence in the product and ultimately convert interested leads into paying customers.

Job Title: Brand Activation \& Operations Executive – Fresher

**Company:** HealthSphere Wellness Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** UltraPeak®  
**Openings:** 3–4  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Brand Activation \& Operations  
**Travel:** Required for brand events

Job Description

HealthSphere Wellness Pvt. Ltd. is looking for **energetic, confident and well\-spoken freshers** to join our growing team as **Brand Activation \& Operations Executives**.

This is a **multi\-functional role** designed for candidates who want practical exposure to brand events, marketing, customer interaction, administration and day\-to\-day startup operations.

A major responsibility will be supporting **UltraPeak® at Devil’s Circuit events across multiple cities**. Candidates should therefore be confident approaching new people, communicating in Hindi and English, conducting short participant interviews, and representing the brand professionally.

When not attending events, candidates will work from the office and support different departments with coordination, documentation and general operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Represent **UltraPeak®** professionally at events and brand activations.
* Interact with participants and explain the brand/products.
* Conduct short **on\-camera interviews** with participants, athletes and visitors.
* Assist with product sampling and giveaways.
* Encourage visitors to participate in UltraPeak engagement activities.
* Help collect customer feedback, leads and other event data.
* Coordinate with the social media team for event content and interviews.
* Assist the team with event setup, execution and on\-ground coordination.
* Be willing to **travel to different cities** for Devil’s Circuit and other company events.
* Maintain office files, documents and records.
* Perform basic data entry and maintain Excel/Google Sheets.
* Assist with calls, emails, follow\-ups and internal coordination.
* Support marketing, e\-commerce, operations and administration teams whenever required.
* Perform other reasonable operational responsibilities required in a growing startup.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate in any stream; **freshers are encouraged to apply**.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* **Good spoken Hindi and English.**
* Confident speaking with strangers and large groups.
* Comfortable appearing and speaking **on camera**.
* Smart, energetic and presentable personality.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Word, Excel and Google Sheets**.
* Good organizational and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel for events.
* Ability to work in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn different areas of the business.

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for someone who does **not want a routine desk\-only job**. You will get exposure to **brand activation, events, marketing, social media content, customer interaction, administration and business operations**.

We are looking for candidates who can confidently say:

**“Give me a responsibility, and I’ll learn how to get it done.”**

What You'll Get

You will have an opportunity to work closely with the core HealthSphere team, participate in major UltraPeak events, interact directly with customers and athletes, and understand how a new consumer brand is built from the ground up.

**Indeed Job Title:** **Brand Activation \& Operations Executive (Fresher)**  
**Number of Vacancies:** **3–4**

For screening, I would make **good communication skills \+ confidence on camera \+ willingness to travel** the three most important selection criteria, rather than marks or previous work experience.

Pay: ₹15,974\.53 \- ₹25,752\.04 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Business Development Manager – Upwork
description:
**Company Description**  

We at Prometteur Solutions Pvt. Ltd. are a team of IT experts, who came with a promise of delivering technology\-empowered business solutions. We provide world\-class software and web development services that focus on playing a supportive role to your business and its holistic growth. Our highly\-skilled associates and global delivery capabilities ensure the accessibility and scale to align client's technology solutions with their business needs. Our offerings span the entire IT lifecycle: from Consulting through Packaged, Custom, and Cloud Applications as well as a variety of Infrastructure Services.

 **Job Description**  

You will own Prometteur's entire Upwork channel — bidding strategy, agency profiles, manager


profiles, lead qualification, proposals, calls, closure, and the team that supports it. You will


personally close mid\-to\-high\-ticket projects and lead a small team of junior BDEs/freshers who


handle bidding and lead generation under your direction. You carry both an individual closure


target and a team revenue target. This is a senior, hands\-on, AI\-first role with a clear path into a


Channel Head / Sales Head seat as the team scales.


Important: This is an AI\-first sales role. We expect you to use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and


modern sales\-AI tooling daily — for proposals, lead research, follow\-ups, profile/portfolio


refresh, competitor analysis, and team productivity. Comfort with AI is non\-negotiable.


What You'll Own


Channel \& Profile Ownership

* Run and optimize multiple Upwork agency accounts and manager profiles in parallel —


each tuned to a service line, geography, or client tier.

* Own JSS, response rate, top\-rated / rising\-talent badges, and overall account health


across every profile.

* Build a connects\-allocation strategy across accounts — what bids, how often, at what


price, with which profile.

* Continuously refresh portfolios, case studies, niche specializations, and agency


descriptions to stay first\-page on relevant searches.


Team Leadership

* Lead a team of 2–3 junior BDEs / freshers — set daily and weekly bidding targets,


review every proposal before it goes out, and monitor connect spend.

* Onboard and train freshers on Upwork dynamics, lead qualification, proposal writing,


scoping conversations, and client handling.

* Run daily stand\-ups and weekly 1:1s; track each BDE's pipeline, win rate, and proposal


quality.

* Build the team's playbook — proposal templates per service line, qualification checklists,


follow\-up cadences, objection handling.


Sales Execution

* Personally close mid\-to\-high\-ticket projects in IT services — web, mobile, custom


software, SaaS, cloud, AI — across global clients.

* Run discovery calls on Zoom with founders and decision\-makers; scope, structure, and


close commercial proposals.

* Coordinate with the delivery / tech team for SOWs, estimations, and pre\-sales technical


scoping.

* Negotiate commercials, payment terms, and milestone structures.


Pipeline, CRM \& Reporting

* Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene in HubSpot — every active lead logged, deal stage


updated, next step set.

* Hit personal monthly closure target AND team\-level monthly revenue target.
* Report weekly to leadership on closures, pipeline health, win/loss reasons, and team


performance.

* Spot trends in the Upwork market — verticals, project sizes, geographies, price points


that are converting — and tune team strategy accordingly.


AI\-Powered Workflow

* Use ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini daily for proposal drafting, personalization, lead and


company research, follow\-ups, and rejection\-recovery messages.

* Build and maintain reusable AI prompt libraries for the team — proposal templates by


service line, discovery\-call prep, scope clarifications, objection handling.

* Use AI for portfolio and case\-study refresh, profile/agency description optimization, and


SEO\-friendly Upwork copy.

* Deploy AI for competitive intel — analyze who's winning similar jobs, at what price, with


what positioning, and feed insights back into bidding.

* Train freshers to bid faster and smarter with AI — without sacrificing quality,


personalization, or compliance with Upwork ToS.

* Continuously evaluate new sales\-AI tooling (Clay, Apollo, Lavender, etc.) and roll in what


works.


Must\-Haves

* 3\+ years of hands\-on selling on Upwork with verifiable closures in IT services


(non\-iGaming).

* Has handled multiple Upwork agency accounts and manager profiles simultaneously —


knows how to run them without crossover or policy issues.

* Proven team\-management experience — has led or mentored at least 1–2 BDEs /


bidders, with clear ownership of their output and targets.

* Deep working knowledge of Upwork: JSS, profile rank, connects, agency vs. freelancer


accounts, badges, boosting, dispute handling, ToS boundaries.

* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini — for proposals,


research, and follow\-ups. Anyone not using AI in their workflow is not a fit.

* Strong written English — proposal writing should be a competitive advantage; AI is your


amplifier, not your crutch.

* Confident on discovery calls and negotiations with international clients.
* CRM discipline — HubSpot, Zoho, or equivalent — and comfort with outreach / tracking


tooling.

* Self\-driven, structured, target\-oriented; willing to be on\-site in Surat.


Nice\-to\-Haves

* Experience on additional freelance platforms — Codeur, Contra, Toptal, Freelancer.
* Background selling custom software, mobile apps, AI, or cloud / DevOps services.
* Built or maintained a personal AI prompt library / workflow for sales tasks.
* Hiring experience — has helped recruit and ramp junior BDEs.


What You Get

* Full ownership of one of Prometteur's strongest acquisition channels from Day 1\.
* Team to lead from the start — no waiting to earn the leadership track.
* Performance incentive tied to both your closures and your team's output.
* Clear growth path into Channel Head / Sales Head as the team scales.

title: Assistant - Learning Transformation
description:
**Job Description – Assistant – Learning Transformation**

**Position \-** Assistant \- Learning Transformation

**Reporting To \-** Director \- Learning Transformation

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail\-oriented individual to support the execution of learning transformation and daily operational activities. The role requires coordinating with internal teams, trainers, centre staff, industry partners, and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks and smooth execution of initiatives.

The ideal candidate should be an excellent communicator, highly organized, comfortable working with data, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project \& Task Coordination**

* Assist in planning and executing transformation and strategic projects.
* Coordinate with internal departments, canters, trainers, and external stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
* Maintain action trackers and ensure timely follow\-up with stakeholders.
* Prepare meeting agendas, MOMs (Minutes of Meeting), and monitor action closures.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary coordination point between various internal and external stakeholders.
* Schedule meetings and ensure effective communication among teams.
* Follow up regularly to ensure commitments are completed on time.
* Escalate delays or risks proactively.

**Academic Operations Support**

* Monitor classroom delivery and implementation of academic initiatives.
* Track classroom outcomes, student engagement, attendance, assessments, and project completion.
* Coordinate with trainers and Centre teams for timely submission of reports.
* Support implementation of new curriculum, teaching methodologies, and academic interventions.

**Reporting \& Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Maintain dashboards and trackers using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Organize project documentation and maintain records.

**Administrative Support**

* Assist in organizing workshops, training programs, webinars, and meetings.
* Coordinate logistics with multiple teams.
* Maintain project calendars and schedules.
* Support day\-to\-day operational activities assigned by the reporting manager.

**Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
* Ability to prepare reports and dashboards.
* Familiarity with project management tools is an advantage.
* Tech background will be an added advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Professional attitude with a customer\-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (Education, Management, Engineering, or IT preferred).
* 1\-3 years of experience in project coordination, academic operations, administration, or stakeholder management. Freshers can also apply.
* Experience in the Education, EdTech, Training, or Skill Development sector will be preferred.

**Preferred Profile**

The ideal candidate should be someone who:

* Enjoys coordinating with people and ensuring tasks are completed.
* Is comfortable handling multiple assignments simultaneously.
* Can communicate confidently with trainers, centre teams, and leadership.
* Is proactive in identifying issues and following up until closure.
* Has a structured and process\-oriented approach to work.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of assigned projects and action items.
* Stakeholder response and follow\-up closure rates.
* Accuracy and timeliness of reports and documentation.
* Classroom monitoring and reporting compliance.
* Quality of project coordination and communication.
* Meeting operational deadlines.
* Overall support in successful execution of transformation initiatives.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Backend Engineer, Clinical AI
description:
**OutcomesAI** 
 is a healthcare technology company building an AI\-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
   

  

 Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post\-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.
   

  

**Our core product suite includes:**
* Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence\-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt\-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow\-ups
* Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena
* AI\-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis)


 Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text\-to\-speech (TTS) — fine\-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA\-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first
 **AI \+ nurse hybrid workforce** 
 , improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.
   

  

**The Role**
 This sits across backend, platform and AI engineering. Three kinds of work, and you would not do them in equal measure — the balance follows what you are good at and what you want to get better at.
   

  

  

* Backend and data. Multi\-tenant services and APIs in TypeScript or python over MongoDB. Clinical content modelling: identity, deduplication, versioning, audit
* The authoring platform. The tools clinical operations staff use to read and configure triage behaviour — including making genuinely complex logic reviewable by people who are clinicians, not engineers
* The triage engine. The real\-time Python service that runs the calls. Open to you as far as your curiosity takes you


**The part people find interesting**
**A real\-time clinical voice agent that cannot be allowed to improvise.**
 The engine is a hybrid: a deterministic decision graph over clinical content, wrapped in LLM work that has to stay on a leash. Language models handle understanding — extracting facts from what a caller said, classifying answers, screening every turn for life\-threatening cues. The clinical decision itself stays deterministic.
   

  

 The engineering problems that come with that are the good ones: sub\-second latency budgets, what to do when a model call times out mid\-call, how a safety screen fails open without failing silently, and how you evaluate any of it against recorded sessions rather than vibes.
   

  

 Most engineers here start on the platform side and move toward the engine as they pick up the domain. That learning curve — clinical triage content, real\-time voice, LLM orchestration under safety constraints — is the main reason to take this job over a similar one somewhere else.
   

  

 You do not need to have built this before. You do need to want to.
   

  

**What We Look For**
* Strong TypeScript skills with working proficiency in Python. You should be comfortable reading, understanding, and working across the codebase, even when you are not directly modifying every component
* Sound data modelling and schema design judgement. You understand concepts such as identity, versioning, natural keys, stable identifiers, and how data\-model decisions affect long\-term system behaviour
* A verification\-first mindset. When determining how the system behaves, you validate it through the implementation, data, or evidence rather than relying on assumptions. This is especially important in clinical systems, where incorrect conclusions can have significant consequences
* Ability to communicate clearly with non\-engineering users. Product labels, explanations, and system behaviour should be understandable to clinicians and operational teams. If the interface can be easily misunderstood, we consider that a product issue rather than a training issue
* Transparency about scope and trade\-offs. Priorities change and scope may need to be reduced. We value engineers who clearly communicate what was completed, what was deferred, and any resulting implications


**Technical Stack**
* TypeScript (Strict Mode)
* Node.js \& Express
* MongoDB
* Python
* LLM Orchestration
* Real\-Time Voice Systems
* Vite
* Vitest
* AWS


**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**
* You are primarily looking for a greenfield environment. Much of the work involves evolving and strengthening an existing system that users already depend on
* You prioritize feature volume over system correctness. We value getting critical boundaries, interfaces, and behaviours right rather than maximizing the number of features shipped
* You want to focus primarily on model development. This role is more about building the reliable system around AI models—especially how the product behaves when a model is uncertain, inconsistent, or wrong

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Engineer I - C++ developer
description:
Are you ready to join a world\-class team at Aristocrat, where innovation and collaboration drive our success? As an Engineer I, you will make a significant impact on our Agile game development team. At Aristocrat, we are committed to bringing happiness to life through the power of play, and you will play a crucial role in achieving our mission! This opportunity is perfect for ambitious recent graduates or early\-career engineers eager to build a solid foundation in game development alongside our experienced team members.
   

  

 What You'll Do

 What We're Looking For

* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Enthusiasm to learn, adjust, and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science/Engineering or related field.
* 1\-2 years of professional software engineering experience.

**Compensation Philosophy**

description:

 Entwine Technologies specializes in high\-quality embedded systems and software solutions, with a focus on intelligent and reliable technologies. The company brings expertise across hardware and firmware to deliver robust products for the food and beverage industry. Team members collaborate closely to design, develop, and refine embedded solutions that meet demanding performance and quality standards. Entwine Technologies offers opportunities to work on cutting\-edge projects and contribute to innovative, real\-world systems.

 This is a full\-time, on\-site Embedded Systems Engineer (Hardware \+ Firmware) role located in Bhiwandi (Thane District; Mumbai). The engineer will design, develop, and test embedded hardware and firmware for new and existing products, including schematics review, component selection, and board\-level integration. Responsibilities include implementing and debugging embedded software, integrating sensors and communication modules, and optimizing systems for performance, reliability, and energy efficiency. The engineer will also troubleshoot issues, participate in design reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement of development processes and standards.

 * Develop embedded firmware using C/C\+\+ for ARM, STM32, ESP32, AVR, or PIC microcontrollers.

* Debug firmware and hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters.

 Required Skills

* Understanding of PCB schematics and basic PCB layout concepts.
* Familiarity with communication protocols (UART, SPI, I²C, CAN).

* Basic understanding of RTOS and version control (Git) is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


 Qualification
 * B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics \& Communication, Embedded Systems, Electrical \& Electronics, or a related field.
* 2\-4 years of experience in embedded hardware and firmware development.

title: Backend Developer (Node.js + Python) — for the 6 mid openings
description:
Company Description
 



 Evatril is an AI\-powered digital invitation and event management platform that enables individuals and organizations to create, share, and manage event invitations with ease. Using AI\-assisted invitation creation, smart RSVP tracking, and seamless multi\-channel sharing, Evatril simplifies communication between hosts and guests. A major focus of our product right now is Memories, a shared photo and video album experience where hosts and guests can collaboratively capture, relive, and preserve moments from an event long after it ends. Evatril is expanding toward smarter, integrated event experiences that connect people across the entire event journey, from the first invite to the last shared memory. Team members contribute to a fast\-growing, product\-focused environment driven by innovation and real user impact.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We're hiring 6 Backend Developers (Node.js \+ Python) for our engineering team in Bhubaneswar — 3 openings for developers with 1\-2 years of experience, and 3 openings for freshers (0\-1 year) ready to build real, production software from day one. We're not gatekeeping by years on a resume: what matters most is whether you can take a problem, own it, and grow into more responsibility fast. Whether this is your first developer role or you've already got a couple of years behind you, you'll get genuine ownership of features here, not just tickets — freshers included. Everyone on this team works on the same real product, including active work on Memories, our shared photo/video album feature, with senior engineers around to guide you rather than just review your code.
 



  





 Day\-to\-day work includes API development, database design and queries, writing clean and tested code in Node.js and Python, troubleshooting production issues, and collaborating directly with our product and frontend teams.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bhubaneswar. All new hires join on a 3\-month probation period, with compensation reviewed and revised based on your performance during that time.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 \- Working knowledge of Node.js and Python — through a professional role, internship, coursework, or a serious personal/open\-source project
 



 \- Understanding of RESTful API design and basic database concepts (relational and/or NoSQL)
 



 \- Comfortable with Git and collaborative development workflows
 



 \- Strong problem\-solving instincts and a genuine bias toward ownership — you take a task and run with it rather than waiting to be told what's next
 



 \- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Cloudflare) is a plus, especially for the more experienced band — not required to apply
 



 \- A degree in Computer Science or a related field is welcome but not required — we care more about what you can build than where you studied
 



  





 Please mention your total years of hands\-on experience in your application — this helps us place you against the right opening among the 6\.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Automation Engineering Manager
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities, under the supervision of senior engineers. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost\-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also showcase your knowledge by collecting data and supporting production of the engineering design.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: \- Onsite
   

  

 This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in Chennai\-India region. Main stakeholders include Customers, Application Engineering Team, Project Management Team, Testing \& Commissioning Team, and Product Development Team.
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Planning, monitoring, and executing application development tasks, including new product development, incremental modifications, and timely closure of assigned work.
* Providing technical support for testing, installation, commissioning, debugging, and diagnostics activities.
* Translating conceptual designs into detailed engineering documentation through modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations, while applying design thinking and best practices.
* Assisting in preparing engineering proposals and presentations and maintaining effective communication with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identifying and managing project risks/issues, ensuring compliance with organizational standards, and promoting teamwork, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction


**Qualifications for the role:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Instrumentation / Automation or related discipline).
* Minimum 1\-3 years of application development and support experience.
* Well\-developed understanding of Industrial Automation systems like PLCs, motors, drives, motion control and robotic systems
* Demonstrable experience in building strong and enduring customer relationships within highly dynamic and competitive markets
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a global environment.
* Willing to travel for site support and commissioning as required.


**More about us:**
 B\&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B\&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B\&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics \& Discrete Automation division.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager — Quality Control & Quality Assurance (Rice Industry)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Manager / Assistant Manager — Quality Control \& Quality Assurance**

*Majestic Basmati Rice Pvt Ltd.*

**Department:** Quality Assurance \& Quality Control\- Rice Industry

**Function:** Quality / Food Safety

**Location:** Bhopal

**Reporting To:** Director of Company

**Experience:** 2–5\+ Years (Freshers can also apply in internship is done in Rice Industry)

**1\. Job Summary**

Own product quality, food safety, regulatory and export compliance, and customer specification adherence across the value chain — from raw\-material procurement through processing, milling, packaging, storage, and dispatch. The role covers Basmati Rice quality parameters, lab testing, quality systems, export requirements, third\-party/customer audits, CAPA, and continuous improvement, working closely with Procurement, Production, Milling, Packaging, Warehouse, Export, and Commercial teams.

**2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Quality Control — Raw Material, Process \& Finished Product**

* Monitor and control quality across procurement, inward receipt, processing, milling, packaging, storage, and dispatch.
* Sample and inspect raw paddy, raw rice, semi\-finished and finished rice, packaging materials, and export consignments; conduct physical, chemical, sensory, and applicable microbiological analysis.
* Verify compliance against internal, customer, statutory, and export specifications.
* Manage segregation, identification, quarantine, release, rejection, and disposition of non\-conforming material; act on process deviations promptly.

**3\. Basmati Rice Quality Parameters**

Monitor and document: grain length, breadth, and L/B ratio; broken %, head rice % / recovery; moisture, foreign matter, paddy admixture; chalky, damaged/discoloured, immature, and red grains and other defects; milling yield and recovery; purity and varietal integrity; aroma, colour, appearance, uniformity, cleanliness; cooking characteristics and elongation; and other customer/destination\-country specifications.

**4\. Export Quality, Compliance, Audits \& InspectionExport Quality Requirements**

* Track country\-specific import requirements for served markets; ensure compliance with customer/export specs for physical, chemical, and microbiological parameters, pesticide/residue, heavy metals, mycotoxins/aflatoxins, food safety, packaging/labelling, and shelf\-life/storage.
* Ensure adherence to FSSAI, Codex, importing\-country regulations, and customer/statutory standards.
* Maintain approved specifications per export customer/market and align them with purchase orders and contracts, coordinating with Export/Commercial before production and dispatch.

**Export Inspection \& Pre\-Shipment Inspection**

* Coordinate pre\-shipment inspection with customers, third\-party agencies, surveyors, certifiers, and labs, per applicable protocols.
* Prepare export and retention samples; verify inspection reports and resolve deviations before shipment; ensure external lab testing and final quality clearance for dispatch.
* Ensure timely, accurate COA, test/inspection reports, declarations, and other export documents; investigate and resolve inspection failures or rejections.

**Export Audits \& Customer Audits**

* Coordinate and participate in customer, food safety, certification, buyer, regulatory, surveillance, and supplier/compliance audits.
* Prepare the plant, lab, documentation, and personnel for scheduled and surprise audits; ensure timely closure of observations.
* Prepare and track CAPA against audit findings to verified closure; maintain an audit calendar and address recurring observations with preventive controls.

**5\. Laboratory \& Quality Equipment Management**

* Operate, maintain, calibrate, and document QC lab equipment: moisture meter/analyzer, rice grain analyzer, grain length \& breadth equipment, rice grader, weighing/analytical balances, sieve/grain\-size equipment, dehuller/lab rice sheller, lab or mini rice mill, milling and head\-rice\-recovery/yield analysis equipment, kernel dimension/image analysis, colour measurement system, chalky\-grain/defect analyzer, and hot air oven (reference\-method moisture).
* Coordinate pesticide/residue and other specialised testing through approved external laboratories.
* Ensure calibration/verification per schedule; maintain certificates, history, and maintenance records; restrict use to trained personnel.
* Set testing methods and acceptance criteria; investigate abnormal results; maintain reference standards where applicable.
* Coordinate servicing/breakdown resolution, lab housekeeping/5S/safety, and evaluate new equipment needs.

**6\. Quality Assurance \& Food Safety Systems**

* Develop, implement, and maintain QA procedures, SOPs, work instructions, and quality manuals.
* Implement and monitor HACCP, GMP, GHP, ISO 22000, BRCGS, FSSAI, customer\-specific systems, and export\-market requirements.
* Monitor hygiene, sanitation, pest control, environmental controls, and food safety practices; conduct internal quality/hygiene/warehouse audits and close findings.
* Maintain quality, food safety, traceability, testing, inspection, and compliance documentation.

**7\. Customer Complaints, NCR \& CAPA**

* Investigate complaints on grain quality, appearance, aroma, moisture, broken %, packaging, foreign matter, pest infestation, cooking quality, chemical/microbiological parameters, and other concerns.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis, raise NCRs, and implement effective CAPA; track closure, verify effectiveness, and control repeat complaints.

**8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Procurement — raw\-material specs and supplier quality; Production/Milling — process quality and deviations; Packaging — material and packing\-quality requirements.
* Warehouse — storage hygiene, pest control, FIFO/FEFO, and preservation; Export/Commercial — customer specs, inspections, and shipment clearance; external labs and inspection agencies as needed.
* Act as quality gatekeeper for raw\-material, process, and finished\-product release.

**9\. Training \& Team Management**

* Lead and supervise QC/QA personnel and ensure adequate coverage across shifts.
* Train staff on product specifications, sampling/testing, GMP/GHP, food safety, hygiene, SOPs, export requirements, and customer specifications.
* Maintain training records and evaluate effectiveness.

**10\. Required Qualification**

B.Tech/B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Science, Agriculture, related field. Certification in HACCP, Food Safety, ISO 22000, BRCGS, Quality Management, or Internal Auditor is an advantage.

**11\. Experience**

2–5\+ years in Quality Control/Assurance, preferably in Rice, Basmati Rice, Grain Processing, Flour Mills, Food Processing, FMCG, or Agricultural Commodities, ideally with an export\-oriented organization. Experience with customer, certification, regulatory, and third\-party audits, and exposure to export inspections and international customer specifications, is strongly preferred.

**12\. Required Technical Skills**

* QC/QA principles; Basmati Rice quality parameters, grading, and milling yield
* Laboratory testing, sampling, inspection, and product release
* Export quality requirements and customer/third\-party inspection procedures
* Food Safety Management Systems: HACCP / GMP / GHP, ISO 22000 / BRCGS, FSSAI
* Audit management; CAPA / RCA / NCR; traceability and recall systems
* Laboratory equipment and calibration; quality documentation and reporting; supplier quality management

**13\. Preferred Candidate Profile**

A hands\-on Quality professional with strong Basmati Rice / Rice Processing / Food Manufacturing experience, able to run both plant\-level QC and QA systems — with practical exposure to rice quality analysis, lab equipment, milling parameters, export specs, pre\-shipment inspections, audits, CAPA, food safety systems, and team management. Independent and uncompromising on quality, food safety, and compliance, while working collaboratively with operations and commercial teams.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Telecaller
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONTravel Telecaller – B2B Lead Generation

**Company:** DreamTrawell  
**Department:** Business Development  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Director

About DreamTrawell

DreamTrawell is a growing Destination Management Company (DMC) specialising in domestic and international travel solutions. We work with travel agents, tour operators, corporate clients and individual travellers to provide customised packages, competitive rates and end\-to\-end travel solutions.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced **Travel Telecaller – B2B Lead Generation** who will be responsible for connecting with travel agents, generating enquiries, building relationships and creating a strong pipeline of business opportunities for DreamTrawell.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. B2B Travel Agent Calling

* Make daily outbound calls to **travel agents, travel agencies, tour operators and travel consultants**.
* Introduce DreamTrawell and explain our destinations, packages, services and business proposition.
* Establish contact with new travel agents and identify potential business opportunities.
* Understand the agent's preferred destinations, customer profile and business requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with existing travel\-agent partners.
* Inform agents about new packages, special offers, destinations and promotional activities.

2\. Lead Generation

* Generate qualified **B2B travel enquiries** through outbound calling.
* Identify agents who have active or upcoming travel requirements.
* Generate leads for domestic and international destinations.
* Qualify leads based on:
* Destination
* Travel dates
* Number of passengers
* Budget
* Type of traveller
* Package requirement
* Pass qualified leads to the Business Development/Sales team for further conversion.
* Maintain a healthy and updated lead pipeline.

3\. Agent Relationship Management

* Build a strong database of travel agents and continuously expand the network.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with agents who have shown interest.
* Develop professional and long\-term relationships with agents over the phone.
* Understand agent requirements and coordinate internally to provide timely responses.
* Ensure regular follow\-up on quotations and pending enquiries.
* Reactivate inactive agents and generate fresh enquiries from the existing database.

4\. Coordination With Sales \& Operations Team

* Coordinate with the Business Development team regarding leads generated.
* Share complete and accurate lead information with the concerned sales executive.
* Coordinate with the operations team wherever required for destination/package information.
* Follow up internally on quotations and ensure timely communication to agents.
* Maintain proper records of all enquiries and their status.

5\. Database \& Reporting

Maintain an updated database containing:

* Agent Name
* Company Name
* Contact Person
* Mobile Number
* City/Location
* Preferred Destinations
* Previous Enquiries
* Current Requirements
* Follow\-up Date
* Lead Status
* Booking Status

Submit **daily/weekly calling and lead\-generation reports** to the reporting manager.

DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The candidate will be expected to maintain consistent calling activity, including:

* **50–80 outbound calls per day** to travel agents.
* Generate a defined number of **qualified leads every day**.
* Regular follow\-up on existing leads.
* Maintain accurate CRM/Excel/Google Sheet records.
* Ensure every qualified lead is properly handed over to the sales team.
* Reactivate inactive agents on a regular basis.

*Targets may be revised based on the candidate's experience and business requirements.*

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will primarily be measured on:

Calling

* Number of calls made
* Number of agents contacted
* Number of meaningful conversations

Lead Generation

* Qualified B2B leads generated
* New active agents identified
* Destination\-wise enquiries generated
* Conversion of leads into quotations

Follow\-Up

* Follow\-ups completed
* Response rate from agents
* Reactivation of inactive agents

Business

* Enquiries converted into bookings
* Revenue generated from leads
* Number of active agents contributing enquiries

CANDIDATE PROFILEExperience

* **1–3 years of experience** in a travel company, DMC, travel agency, tour operator or hospitality industry.
* Prior experience in **B2B travel\-agent calling** will be preferred.
* Candidates who have previously handled travel\-agent databases and outbound calling will be given preference.
* Freshers may be considered if they have excellent communication skills and a strong interest in the travel industry.

Required Skills

* Excellent Hindi and English communication skills.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Strong convincing and negotiation abilities.
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
* Good follow\-up skills.
* Ability to build relationships over the phone.
* Basic knowledge of domestic and international travel destinations.
* Ability to understand travel packages and communicate them effectively.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets / CRM.
* Strong organisational and record\-keeping skills.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The ideal candidate should be:

* Confident and energetic on calls.
* Comfortable speaking with business owners and travel agents.
* Proactive in generating leads.
* Persistent with follow\-ups.
* Target\-oriented.
* Customer and relationship focused.
* A good listener.
* Positive and professional in communication.
* Willing to learn about new destinations and travel products.

ROLE OBJECTIVE

The primary objective of this role is to **build a strong B2B travel\-agent pipeline for DreamTrawell through systematic outbound calling, relationship building and lead generation.**

The candidate should not merely make calls. The expectation is to **identify genuine travel requirements, generate qualified enquiries, nurture agent relationships and create business opportunities for the sales team.**

Career Growth

Based on performance, the candidate can progress into a **B2B Business Development Executive / Business Development Manager** role with responsibility for agent relationships, field visits and revenue generation.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Internet reimbursement

Experience:

* Travel Domain: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Designation:** Sales Executive  
**Department:** Sales  
**Location:** Ather Showroom, Guwahati  
**Reporting To:** Showroom Manager / Sales Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Objective

To drive sales of Ather electric scooters by understanding customer requirements, providing accurate product information, delivering an excellent showroom experience, and converting enquiries into successful sales while achieving assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities1\. Customer Handling \& Product Presentation

* Welcome customers visiting the showroom and understand their requirements, preferences, and budget.
* Explain Ather electric scooters, including features, specifications, variants, range, charging, technology, and benefits.
* Conduct effective product demonstrations and test rides.
* Explain financing, insurance, exchange, accessories, and other available offerings.
* Address customer queries and provide accurate information throughout the sales process.
* Maintain a professional and customer\-friendly approach at all times.

2\. Sales \& Target Achievement

* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets assigned by the management.
* Generate and convert showroom walk\-ins, enquiries, leads, referrals, and digital enquiries into sales.
* Follow up regularly with prospective customers and ensure timely conversion.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and track prospects at different stages.
* Work towards improving enquiry\-to\-booking and booking\-to\-retail conversion ratios.
* Participate in promotional activities, events, exhibitions, and customer engagement initiatives.

3\. Lead Management \& Follow\-Up

* Record all customer enquiries and interactions accurately in the CRM/DMS.
* Make timely follow\-up calls and messages to prospective customers.
* Maintain proper records of hot, warm, and cold leads.
* Reconnect with lost or pending customers and explore opportunities for conversion.
* Ensure that no customer enquiry remains unattended.

4\. Test Ride \& Booking Management

* Explain the test\-ride process and ensure customers have a smooth test\-ride experience.
* Follow up with customers after test rides to understand their feedback and purchase intent.
* Complete booking formalities accurately and coordinate with relevant departments for further processing.
* Keep customers updated regarding documentation, finance, vehicle availability, registration, and delivery.

5\. Customer Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Ensure a positive customer experience from enquiry to vehicle delivery.
* Coordinate with the service and delivery teams whenever required to resolve customer concerns.
* Follow up with customers after delivery to ensure satisfaction and encourage referrals.

6\. Showroom Operations

* Maintain the showroom's sales area, display vehicles, brochures, accessories, and promotional materials in an organized manner.
* Ensure all displayed vehicles are clean, presentable, and ready for customer demonstrations.
* Maintain professional grooming and adhere to the company's dress code and showroom standards.
* Follow all company policies, sales processes, and Ather brand guidelines.

7\. Reporting \& Documentation

* Prepare and submit daily/weekly sales reports as required.
* Maintain accurate records of enquiries, bookings, test rides, retail sales, follow\-ups, and customer feedback.
* Provide regular updates to the Sales Manager regarding sales performance and lead status.
* Ensure all sales documentation is complete and accurate.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales target achievement
* Number of enquiries handled
* Lead conversion ratio
* Test rides conducted
* Test ride\-to\-booking conversion
* Booking\-to\-retail conversion
* Customer follow\-up effectiveness
* Customer satisfaction
* Referral generation
* CRM/DMS data accuracy and compliance
* Timely completion of sales documentation

Candidate ProfileEducational Qualification

* Minimum **12th Pass**; graduate preferred.

Experience

* **1 year of experience in automobile, two\-wheeler, EV, retail, or consumer sales preferred.**
* Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong customer\-handling and convincing abilities.
* Sales\-oriented and target\-driven approach.
* Good negotiation and follow\-up skills.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Ability to maintain CRM/DMS records.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work effectively in a team.

title: BDE (Business Development Executive) (fresher)
description:
**Experience:** Fresher (0\-1 years of experience)

**Location:** Coimbatore (covering Coimbatore, Salem, Erode \& The Nilgiris)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| Office\-based with frequent field travel

**Reporting To:** CEO / Business Head

**Apply To:** hr@avanexa.com

**ABOUT AVANEXA TECHNOLOGIES**

Avanexa Technologies is a Guinness Record\-holding, award\-winning digital solutions company based in Coimbatore, with offices in Bengaluru, Australia, and the USA. For over 20 years, we have partnered with 1,500\+ businesses globally — delivering web design \& development, mobile application development, cloud \& DevOps, digital marketing, UI/UX design, e\-commerce platforms, marketplace listing, and outsourcing services. With an 87% repeat business rate and a portfolio spanning startups to enterprises, Avanexa is the growth partner businesses trust.

We are expanding our Business Development team to deepen our reach across Western Tamil Nadu. If  
you are a driven sales professional who thrives on building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable impact — we want to meet you.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

As a Business Development Executive (Fresher) at Avanexa, you will be trained to support the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline development to assisting in proposal delivery and account growth — across Coimbatore, Salem, Erode, and The Nilgiris. Working under the guidance of senior leadership, you will represent our complete service portfolio including web development, mobile apps, digital marketing, and cloud solutions, targeting SMBs and regional businesses.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Supporting New Business Acquisition**

* Learn to identify, prospect, and qualify new B2B leads across target industries like SMBs, Education, and Manufacturing.
* Assist in managing a sales pipeline through field visits, cold outreach, and participating in industry events.
* Support discovery calls and site visits; learn to deliver product presentations and live demos of Avanexa’s offerings.
* Assist in preparing commercial quotations and drafting responses to RFPs or tenders.
* Learn negotiation techniques and how to manage objections professionally to help close deals.

**Account Management \& Growth**

* Nurture and grow existing client accounts through proactive check\-ins, quarterly reviews, and
* value\-driven conversations.
* Drive upselling and cross\-selling across Avanexa’s service lines (e.g., SEO for existing web clients, mobile apps for website clients).
* Ensure timely contract renewals and high client satisfaction; escalate delivery concerns to internal teams promptly.
* Act as the primary relationship owner for your accounts, coordinating internally with delivery, design, and marketing teams.

**Collections \& Financial Hygiene**

* Follow up on outstanding invoices and Accounts Receivable (AR) in coordination with the finance team.
* Ensure adherence to agreed payment milestones; resolve disputes diplomatically while protecting business interests.
* Maintain accurate records of invoices, payment timelines, and credit terms per client.

**Reporting, Task Management \& Market Intelligence**

* Maintain up\-to\-date records in Asana covering all client interactions, pipeline stages, follow\-up tasks, and deal notes.
* Submit accurate weekly/monthly MIS reports — pipeline health, conversion rates, revenue booked, and collection status.
* Track competitor offerings, pricing trends, and regional market shifts; share actionable intelligence with leadership.
* Plan and execute territory coverage schedules efficiently to maximize client touchpoints.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience \& Track Record**

* Fresher with a strong interest in B2B technology sales and a high potential for growth in a fast\-paced environment.
* Eagerness to learn the sales process and a demonstrable drive to achieve results. ● Prior exposure to selling to SMBs, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, or manufacturing businesses is a strong advantage.
* Experience managing AR, collections follow\-ups, invoicing processes, and credit terms negotiation.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Outstanding verbal and written communication in Tamil and English; proficiency in additional regional languages is a bonus.
* Strong consultative selling skills — ability to understand client problems and map them to Avanexa’s solutions.
* Confident presenter: comfortable conducting demos, delivering proposals, and leading commercial negotiations independently.
* High degree of self\-motivation, ownership mindset, and resilience in field sales environments.
* Proficiency with Asana for task and pipeline tracking; comfort with MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Strong market knowledge of Coimbatore, Salem, Erode, and The Nilgiris business ecosystems is preferred.

**Logistics \& Availability**

* Willingness to travel extensively within the region; valid driving license and personal two\-wheeler or four\-wheeler preferred.
* Ability to operate independently in the field with minimal daily supervision.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, Marketing, or a related discipline. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales/Marketing is an advantage, not a barrier.

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Monthly and quarterly revenue targets — new business won vs. plan.
* Pipeline health — active opportunities, conversion rate, average deal size, and deal velocity. Accounts Receivable — DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) within agreed thresholds. Renewal and upsell rate across managed accounts.
* Asana hygiene score — completeness and accuracy of task records and pipeline notes. Net Promoter Score (NPS) / client satisfaction feedback from your accounts.

**WHY JOIN AVANEXA?**

* Work with a Guinness Record\-holding company with 20\+ years of legacy and a globally active client base across India, Australia, and the USA.
* Represent a full\-stack service portfolio — no single\-product limitation. Sell websites, apps, cloud, digital marketing, and more.
* Performance\-linked incentive structure that rewards closers and relationship\-builders equally. Collaborative, high\-energy team culture with direct access to leadership and fast decision\-making.
* Clear growth path into Senior BDE, Team Lead, and Regional Sales Manager roles as the team scales.
* Coimbatore headquarters with a growing regional footprint — be part of the core team that shapes the Western Tamil Nadu market.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your updated resume to hr@avanexa.com with the subject line:

“BDE Application – \[Your Name] – \[City]”

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5 working days for an initial screening call.

**For queries:** \+919566381777 \| www. avanexa.com/careers

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 As an Associate Product Manager (APM), you will operate at the intersection of customers, engineering, and business stakeholders—translating complex, real\-world user problems into clear, structured product requirements that development teams can implement. You report directly to the Director of Product and will collaborate closely with engineering, client\-facing teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements. Your main goal is clarity: producing well\-structured PRDs, user stories, and documentation that eliminate ambiguity. This role is ideal for someone who thinks rigorously, writes precisely, and thrives in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Requirements \& Documentation
   

  

* Translate user problems, pains, and requirements into well\-structured product requirement documents (PRDs) that guide engineering development.
* Write clear, structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation for both internal and external audiences.
* Gather input from multiple stakeholders — customers, internal teams, and market signals — into actionable documentation that supports product development and decision\-making.
* Create and maintain product documentation to keep it current as features and workflows change.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Team Managers, Engineering, and client\-facing teams to gather, analyze, and document product requirements.
* Facilitate requirement discussions and workshops to identify the right questions and bring clarity to ambiguous problem statements.
* Act as a coordination layer between product, engineering, and business teams—ensuring everyone shares a common understanding.


 Analysis \& Market Intelligence
   

  

* Contribute to market and competitive intelligence efforts by monitoring industry trends, competitor capabilities, and changing customer use cases.
* Analyze customer feedback, support data, and usage patterns to spot gaps, friction points, and opportunities.
* Assist the Sr. PMs in assessing feature ideas and prioritization decisions through thorough analysis and documentation.


**Who We’re Looking For**
 We hire for four traits above all else. The rest is downstream of these.
   

  

* Clarity in communication: You can take a complex problem and explain it to engineering, sales, and senior stakeholders in a way that each of them can act on. Your documentation is brief, precise, and clear.
* Confident and coachable: You’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and “I was wrong.” You stand your ground when you have evidence and update your view when the evidence suggests otherwise.
* Applied thinking: You analyze user problems thoroughly before jumping to solutions. You work backward from what the user is trying to achieve and notice the secondary questions others overlook.
* Fast learner: You quickly acquire new skills, explore unfamiliar areas, respond to feedback, and figure things out. You don’t wait for instructions on what to do next.


**Qualification \& Requirements**
* 1–3 years of experience in a product, business analysis, consulting, or a related role in a B2B or SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills — you can break down ambiguous problems and clarify them.
* Excellent written communication — your documentation is clear, precise, and easy to understand without a meeting to explain it.
* Proven ability to synthesize inputs from various sources into coherent, actionable documentation.
* Comfort working closely with engineering teams — you don’t need to write code, but you should understand how software systems function.
* Attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. A genuine curiosity about how products work and how users actually experience them.


**Tools \& Technical Skills**
* Familiar with product and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, or similar.
* Comfortable working with data — able to read reports, interpret usage metrics, and identify key insights.
* Experience creating user stories, PRDs, or functional specs is a plus. Exposure to AI or SaaS products is beneficial but not required.
* Basic understanding of APIs or data flows is useful; you don’t need to be technical, but you should have a curiosity about technology.

title: Associate Product Manager - Nek
description:
**About Us** 





  
 


 Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life\-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future. 
 




  
 


 Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.  
 




  
 


 We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way. 
 




  
 


 Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
 







 And this is just the beginning!
   



  
 



**What’s the role?**



  
 


 As an Associate Product Manager at Nek by Jar, you will own the platform and internal systems that power Nek’s day\-to\-day operations. This includes our internal Order Management / CRM tools and key third\-party integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other operational partners.
 







 You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, and external partners to improve these systems, resolve gaps, and support new product initiatives. You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Nek’s overall architecture, services, integrations, and data flows so that you can evaluate the impact of new features across the platform.
   



  
 



**What will be your responsibilities?**
