title: Assistant Manager - HR
description:
**Position Overview**
 The Assistant Manager – HR will be based at the rice manufacturing plant and act as a hands\-on partner to Plant Head
   

  

 – HR, with ownership of Talent Acquisition and Succession Planning for the plant's blue\-collar and white\-collar
   

  

 workforce, alongside the full plant HR charter — Learning \& Development, Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS), Legal
   

  

 \& Statutory Compliance, Performance Management, Payroll \& HR Operations, Employee Relations, and People
   

  

 Belonging/Culture. The incumbent will build people processes that support plant operations, ensure a compliant and
   

  

 safe workplace, and develop organizational capability across shifts and employee categories.
   

  

 Talent Acquisition, Manpower Hiring \& Succession Planning
   

  

 Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end talent acquisition for the plant, acting as the primary driver of hiring strategy, execution, and


 quality of hire across blue\-collar and white\-collar categories.
   

  

* Define role requirements, job descriptions, and competency/skill profiles in collaboration with hiring managers


 and department heads.
   

  

* Build and continuously refine the recruitment strategy — build vs. buy, lateral vs. campus, contract vs.


 permanent — based on role criticality and market availability.
   

  

* Own manpower planning and budgeting in partnership with department/plant heads — headcount forecasting,


 sanctioned strength vs. actual, and seasonal/peak\-season hiring for plant operations.
   

  

* Forecast hiring needs against attrition trends, business growth, and seasonal/plant workforce requirements.
* Drive role\-based/skill\-based hiring — define competency and skill benchmarks for each role and assess


 candidates against specific job requirements rather than pedigree alone.
   

  

 Sourcing, Selection \& Offer Management
   

  

* Build and manage multi\-channel sourcing: job portals, LinkedIn and social/professional networks, recruitment


 consultants/RPO partners, campus placements, employee referral programs, and walk\-ins for plant/blue\-collar
   

  

 hiring.
   

  

* Drive sourcing and closure for blue\-collar hiring through local networks, ITIs, contractors/manpower vendors,


 and walk\-ins, and for white\-collar roles through portals, referrals, and consultants.
   

  

* Develop and maintain a talent pipeline and pool for critical, niche, and recurring roles to reduce time\-to\-fill.
* Negotiate and manage relationships with recruitment agencies and consultants, including empanelment, fee


 structures, and SLA/performance tracking.
   

  

* Drive campus engagement and internship\-to\-hire programs where applicable.
* Screen, shortlist, and coordinate interview panels; conduct HR/behavioural interviews and support


 technical/functional evaluation with hiring managers.
   

  

* Manage assessment tools, reference checks, and background verification processes.
* Own salary benchmarking, compensation structuring, and offer negotiation to ensure competitive, equitable


 offers.
   

  

* Ensure a strong candidate experience through timely communication, structured interview processes, and


 professional offer/rejection handling.
   

  

 Succession Planning
   

  

* Design succession planning frameworks for critical/leadership roles at the plant; identify and develop high\-


 potential talent through talent reviews and 9\-box assessments.
   

  

* Lead succession planning for critical blue\- and white\-collar plant roles — identify successors for key


 operator/supervisory positions and build readiness through job rotation and cross\-training.
   

  

* Maintain a live manpower and succession tracker for the plant, and report hiring/succession status to Plant Head


 – HR and Head – HR.
   

  

 Employer Branding, Onboarding \& Recruitment Governance
   

  

* Strengthen employer branding through careers page content, social media presence, and participation in job


 fairs/industry forums.
   

  

* Design and drive structured onboarding, induction, and buddy programs to ensure smooth new\-hire integration


 and early engagement.
   

  

* Own the joining formalities process — documentation, background checks, pre\-boarding communication, and


 first\-90\-days experience.
   

  

* Track and report recruitment metrics: time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, offer\-to\-joining ratio, panel


 effectiveness, and early attrition of new joiners.
   

  

* Manage recruitment budget, vendor invoices, and consultant payouts within approved limits.
* Maintain the applicant tracking system in HRIS and ensure a compliant, auditable recruitment process.
* Present periodic hiring dashboards and pipeline status to Head – HR; flag risks on critical/aging openings.


 HR Business Partnering (Plant)
   

  

* Act as the primary HR point of contact and strategic partner to plant leadership, translating business priorities


 into people plans and organizational interventions.
   

  

* Partner with department heads on organization design, role structuring, and workforce planning aligned to plant


 capacity and production plans.
   

  

* Provide data\-backed HR insights — headcount, attrition, cost\-to\-company, productivity linkages — to support


 plant\-level business decisions.
   

  

* Drive change management for new initiatives, restructuring, shift/process changes, and automation rollouts,


 ensuring smooth people transitions.
   

  

* Build HR capability at the plant by coaching supervisors and managers on people practices, employee handling,


 and HR policy application.
   

  

 Learning \& Development
   

  

* Conduct training needs identification across departments and shifts, in coordination with functional/plant heads.
* Design and drive the annual training calendar — functional/technical, behavioural, leadership, and


 statutory/mandatory training (safety, GMP, POSH, quality, etc.).
   

  

* Own the induction and onboarding training plan for every new hire; track completion of plant\-specific and role\-


 based training.
   

  

* Maintain training records and ensure closure of mandatory/statutory training compliance for all employee


 categories.
   

  

* Own the plant training calendar end\-to\-end and share regular compliance and completion status with Plant Head


 – HR.
   

  

 Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS)
   

  

* Partner with the Safety/EHS team to drive a zero\-harm culture across the plant — safe work practices, PPE


 compliance, and hazard reporting.
   

  

* Support incident/accident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) from an HR


 and people standpoint.
   

  

* Coordinate statutory safety training, mock drills, and health check\-ups (occupational health, periodic medical


 examinations) for employees and contract workforce.
   

  

* Track EHS compliance status, near\-miss reporting, and safety KPIs; support audits (ISO 45001, factory safety


 inspections, and customer/certification audits).
   

  

* Drive employee welfare initiatives — canteen, rest rooms, drinking water, sanitation, and other statutory welfare


 provisions under the Factories Act.
   

  

 Legal \& Statutory Compliance
   

  

* Ensure full plant\-level compliance with applicable labour laws — Factories Act, PF, ESI, Bonus, Gratuity, POSH,


 Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Minimum Wages Act, and other central/state statutes.
   

  

* Maintain statutory registers, licenses, filings, returns, and renewals; liaise with the labour department, factory


 inspectors, and other government authorities.
   

  

* Own POSH compliance — Internal Committee (IC) constitution, awareness training, and case handling.
* Manage contract labour/vendor compliance, including licensing, documentation, and periodic audits of


 contractor workforce records.
   

  

* Handle disciplinary processes, domestic enquiries, show\-cause notices, and separations in line with legal


 requirements; coordinate with legal counsel on disputes and regulatory updates.
   

  

 Performance Management
   

  

* Drive the end\-to\-end performance management cycle — goal\-setting, mid\-year reviews, annual appraisals, and


 calibration, across staff and workmen categories.
   

  

* Partner with department heads to ensure timely, quality performance conversations and fair, consistent ratings.
* Support the linkage of performance outcomes to increments, promotions, and rewards; track completion rates


 and flag gaps.
   

  

* Facilitate performance improvement plans (PIPs) for underperformers and coach managers on effective


 feedback and documentation.
   

  

 Payroll \& HR Operations
   

  

* Own accurate and timely payroll inputs — attendance, leave, overtime, shift allowances, and statutory


 deductions — in coordination with the payroll/finance team.
   

  

* Ensure timely disbursement of salary, PF, ESI, bonus, gratuity, and full \& final settlements for all employee


 categories.
   

  

* Maintain HRIS data — employee master data, attendance records, and leave balances.
* Manage the joining\-to\-exit employee lifecycle documentation, including offer letters, confirmation, transfers,


 and separation formalities in HRIS.
   

  

 Employee Relations
   

  

* Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances across staff, workmen, and contract workforce; ensure


 fair and timely resolution.
   

  

* Build and maintain a positive relationship with workmen representatives/unions (where applicable), and support


 harmonious industrial relations.
   

  

* Conduct regular floor visits, shift meetings, and one\-on\-ones to stay connected with ground\-level sentiment and


 pre\-empt issues.
   

  

* Support disciplinary and conflict\-resolution processes with fairness, consistency, and adherence to natural justice


 principles.
   

  

 People Belonging, Culture \& Engagement
   

  

* Drive initiatives that build a sense of belonging and inclusion across the workforce, including workmen and


 contract employees.
   

  

* Plan and execute engagement calendars — festivals, town halls, recognition programs, and employee welfare


 events.
   

  

* Run engagement surveys/pulse checks, analyze feedback, and drive action plans in partnership with leadership.
* Champion the employer brand and culture at the plant, ensuring consistency with organizational values and


 people philosophy.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* End\-to\-end talent acquisition — sourcing, stakeholder management, offer negotiation, and employer branding.
* Proven experience leading end\-to\-end manpower hiring and succession planning for both blue\-collar and white\-


 collar workforce, including in a plant/factory setup.
   

  

* HRIS proficiency and recruitment analytics (time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, source mix).
* End\-to\-end HR generalist/HRBP experience, with exposure to a manufacturing or plant environment (rice/food


 processing, FMCG, or agri\-commodities preferred).
   

  

* Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance (Factories Act, PF, ESI, POSH, Contract Labour


 Act, Minimum Wages Act, etc.).
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with EHS coordination and safety compliance in a factory/plant setting.
* Proven experience managing performance management cycles and payroll/HR operations for a blue\-collar and


 staff workforce.
   

  

* Strong employee relations skills, including grievance handling and, where applicable, union/workmen


 engagement.
   

  

* Experience designing and driving L\&D programs, including statutory and safety training.
* 5–10 years of progressive HR experience in a manufacturing/plant environment, with demonstrated ownership


 of end\-to\-end talent acquisition and direct exposure to a unionized/blue\-collar, multi\-shift plant workforce.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent postgraduate degree in HR/Industrial Relations/Labour Law.
* Certification in Talent Acquisition, Labour Law, POSH, EHS/ISO 45001, or HR Analytics is an advantage.
* Hands\-on recruitment expertise — capable of independently driving high\-volume and niche hiring, building


 sourcing pipelines, and managing stakeholders under tight timelines.
   

  

* A hands\-on, ground\-connected HR professional comfortable spending significant time on the shop floor and


 across shifts.
   

  

* Maturity to independently handle sensitive employee, safety, and compliance matters while influencing business


 leaders and partnering closely with plant leadership.
   

  

 Skills: succession planning,training,environment, health, and safety (ehs),talent acquisition,hiring,labour law,compliance,payroll

title: HR Business Partner (India)
description:
**About Us**
 As Southeast Asia's \#1 integrated logistics provider,
 **Teleport** 
 is all about making logistics fast, affordable and reliable.
   

  

 Our mission? To move things across Southeast Asia better than anyone else. We're focused on making next\-day delivery a reality for all.
   

  

 \#TeamTeleport is guided by our values:
 **Move with urgency** 
 — because time is crucial;
 **Aim to pioneer** 
 — constantly innovating to stay ahead;
 **Do it with intent** 
 — delivering with purpose and precision; and
 **Keep it real** 
 — maintaining authenticity and transparency in all we do.
   

  

 Learn more about Teleport here: https://www.teleport.it/
   

  

**THE MANDATE**
 India is one of our fastest\-growing markets, and it is ready for a People function of its own. This is the first time we are putting a dedicated HR Business Partner on the ground here.
   

  

 You would build it: the processes, the manager relationships, and the way People works across our Delhi, Gurugram and Chennai teams and the operations colleagues in the cities beyond them.
   

  

 You would report directly into our Senior HRBP in Kuala Lumpur, with no layer in between, and you would run India.
   

  

 This is a build role rather than a maintain\-the\-machine one. If you have wanted to shape a country People function instead of inheriting somebody else's, this is that seat.
   

  

**A core measure of success:** 
 Twelve months in, India has a People function that runs on its own — documented processes, managers who know exactly who to call, and compliance that stands up to IPO\-grade scrutiny.
   

  

**A DAY IN A LIFE**
 At Teleport, we're building toward IPO — and that means
 **doing the boring things well** 
 . Execution, discipline, and follow\-through matter as much as big ideas.
   

  

 Your day will be varied, often crossing functions, but most of your time will focus on delivering results, owning your scope end\-to\-end, making fast, data\-informed decisions, and following through on fundamentals like reporting, documentation, and processes.
   

  

 How we work matters as much as what we achieve. Doing the basics right, every time, sets us up for success.
   

  

 Most of your time will be spent driving impact through:
   

  

 Business partnering
   

  

* Advising line managers on live employee issues, annual reviews, career conversations, performance concerns and sensitive communications
* Acting as trusted advisor and advocate through talent discussions, probation reviews, performance improvement plans and managed departures
* Serving as the primary People contact for India leadership, and resolving escalations before they become risk


 Employee lifecycle ownership
   

  

* Owning delivery and accountability across the full lifecycle: onboarding, disciplinary, grievance, leave, policy enforcement, career transitions, performance management and exits
* Constituting and servicing the Internal Committee under the POSH Act at every qualifying workplace, briefing the external member, and keeping the annual District Officer filing current
* Owning the India holiday calendar, and the attendance and roster policy for our shift\-based populations


 Statutory and payroll
   

  

* Holding India statutory compliance end\-to\-end: EPFO, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity and Shops \& Establishments registrations in every state we operate in
* Reconciling local payroll and HRIS against Workday as the group system of record, and keeping the two honest
* Carrying India through the Labour Codes transition, including the wage\-definition impact on provident fund and gratuity cost
* Keeping the contingent workforce clean: consultant classification, and principal\-employer obligations wherever contract labour supports our airport and operations sites


**Requirements**
**These are minimum\-requirement skills and a ‘must\-have' for the role:**
* You will travel, and it is built into the role. Regular, planned presence at the Zeal office at the Delhi airport and at the Gurugram office, and at Chennai or Kolkata where the work calls for it. Our operations people work at sites, not at desks, and the People partner they trust is the one they see
* Professional fluency in English and Hindi. A South Indian or Bengali language is an advantage, not a requirement
* You have owned India statutory compliance yourself — EPFO, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments — across more than one state, and can walk us through a filing or a reconciliation you personally fixed. Supervising a vendor who did it is not the same thing
* You have run POSH as the accountable person: constituted an Internal Committee, briefed an external member, handled a complaint end\-to\-end and filed the annual return
* You have handled the harder end of Indian employee relations — non\-confirmations, performance exits, misconduct, contract labour issues — and can explain how you kept the individual's dignity and the company's evidentiary position intact at the same time
* You are comfortable being the only HR person in the room. The rest of the function sits in Kuala Lumpur
* Organised and methodical, with strong problem solving. Clear written English — this role produces letters, case files and papers that are read by group leadership and, occasionally, by lawyers


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Minimum of 4 \- 6 years Human Resources generalist experience or business role providing deep insight into HR related matters


 At Teleport, we're all about creating a diverse and inclusive team where everyone feels valued. We believe that different perspectives make us stronger and help us do logistics better across Southeast Asia. We welcome people from all walks of life and celebrate what makes each of us unique. If you're passionate about making a difference, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Benefits**
**Work\-Life at \#TeamTeleport**
* Unlimited training \-You will have access to a wide range of learning resources including Notion!
* Ditch the Suit \& Tie \- Be comfortable as you are, express your inner Fashionista... as long as it's not a birthday suit!
* Vacation and time away \- Sometimes you need to recharge and come back energized! That's why you will get 90% off flights to destinations within AirAsia's network
* Growth opportunities \- We embrace and take on opportunities to learn and grow at Teleport as we reimagine the way we do things. Yes, we meet the challenge head on as a team, and we celebrate together with you when you succeed and reap the rewards when the hard work pays off!

Marketing Analyst Intern

**Job Type:** Internship

About the Role

We are looking for a **Marketing Analyst Intern** who is analytical, curious, and interested in understanding how marketing strategies impact business growth. The intern will work closely with the marketing team to research markets, analyze data, study competitors, and help identify opportunities for improving marketing performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct **market research** to understand industry trends, customer preferences, and market opportunities.
* Analyze **competitor strategies**, campaigns, pricing, positioning, and online presence.
* Collect, organize, and analyze marketing data from various sources.
* Assist in tracking **marketing KPIs and campaign performance**.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and insights based on marketing data.
* Conduct **customer and audience research** to identify target segments.
* Monitor industry trends, consumer behavior, and emerging marketing opportunities.
* Assist in analyzing website, social media, and digital marketing performance.
* Support the team in developing **data\-driven marketing strategies**.

* Basic understanding of **marketing concepts and market research**.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with **Excel or Google Sheets**.
* Strong research and data interpretation skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to identify patterns and draw meaningful insights from data.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Digital Marketing**.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics or other analytics platforms.
* Understanding of social media and content marketing.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and paid advertising.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools is a plus.

* Practical experience in **market research and marketing analytics**.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONSite Supervisor cum Civil Engineer

**Company:** Brahmani Engineers \& Contractors  
**Position:** Site Supervisor cum Civil Engineer  
**Location:** Nagpur \& Project Sites  
**Employment Type:** Full Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and technically capable **Site Supervisor cum Civil Engineer** to manage day\-to\-day civil construction activities at project sites. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, manpower management, quality control, measurements, material planning, daily reporting and coordination with clients and contractors.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Site Execution**

* As per approved drawing, BOQ and specifications work execute karwana.
* Daily site activities plan aur monitor karna.
* Civil construction, repair, renovation, demolition and maintenance works supervise karna.
* Work progress ko project schedule ke according maintain karna.

**2\. Labour \& Manpower Management**

* Masons, labourers and subcontractors ko daily work allocate karna.
* Labour attendance aur productivity monitor karna.
* Labour requirement ka advance planning karna.
* Team discipline aur site productivity maintain karna.

**3\. Quality Control**

* Construction work ki quality continuously check karna.
* Material aur workmanship specifications ke according ensure karna.
* Defective/incorrect work ko identify karke rectify karwana.
* Rework aur material wastage control karna.

**4\. Measurement \& Billing**

* Daily measurements accurately record karna.
* BOQ ke according executed quantity verify karna.
* Measurement sheets/MB ke liye required data prepare karna.
* Client/department measurement ke time proper coordination karna.
* RA bills aur final billing ke liye quantity data provide karna.

**5\. Material Management**

* Site par required material ki timely requirement dena.
* Material receiving aur quantity verification karna.
* Cement, steel, sand, aggregate, tiles and other materials ka proper utilisation ensure karna.
* Material wastage aur unnecessary consumption control karna.

**6\. Daily Reporting**

* Daily Progress Report (DPR) prepare karna.
* Daily work completed, manpower, material consumption aur site issues report karna.
* Site photographs aur progress updates maintain karna.
* Any delay, shortage or technical issue immediately management ko report karna.

**7\. Drawing \& Technical Work**

* Civil drawings ko read aur understand karna.
* Site dimensions aur levels check karna.
* Drawing ke according execution ensure karna.
* Site par required basic technical decisions lena aur major issues management/engineer ke saath discuss karna.

**8\. Client \& Department Coordination**

* Client representatives, government department officials, consultants and subcontractors ke saath coordination.
* Site inspection aur work verification ke liye proper preparation.
* Site\-related queries ka timely resolution.

Required Qualification

* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering preferred.
* Civil construction/site supervision ka practical experience preferred.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge may also be considered.

Required Skills

* AutoCAD/drawing reading knowledge.
* BOQ \& quantity measurement knowledge.
* Basic estimation knowledge.
* MS Excel/Google Sheets knowledge.
* DPR and site documentation.
* Labour \& subcontractor management.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently at project sites.

Personal Qualities

* Responsible and disciplined.
* Honest and reliable.
* Good leadership skills.
* Punctual and regular.
* Strong site monitoring ability.
* Quality\-conscious and result\-oriented.

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Complete work within the planned timeline.
* Maintain required quality standards.
* Control material wastage.
* Maintain proper labour productivity.
* Submit accurate daily reports and measurements.
* Ensure proper site discipline and safety.
* Keep management informed about site progress and problems.

Salary

**₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month \+ applicable incentives/allowances**, depending on qualification, experience and performance.

Reporting To

**Project Manager / Proprietor**

Job Type

**Full\-Time \| Site Based**

**Candidate should be willing to travel to different project sites as required.**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 We're Deepwork Technologies, the team behind Floww.ai — an AI\-powered platform that helps businesses and governments run their most complex work, from sales teams to government services. We're a fast\-growing startup with a young, talented team of alumni from IITs and other premier institutes, building technology that runs complex real\-world operations at scale.
 



  





 Among the platforms we have built is BuildNow, the Telangana Government's Next\-Gen Unified Building \& Layout Approval System and one of India's most successful digital governance platforms.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 You’ll be responsible for the data stack end\-to\-end — the warehouse, transformation layer, metrics, and AI agents built on top of them. The transformation layer involves turning raw data into clean, structured, tested, and reliable data that can be used for reporting, analysis, and decision\-making. You’ll work closely with leadership and product teams to understand what they need from the data and deliver it. You’ll be responsible for ensuring the data is accurate, timely, and dependable. This role is ideal for someone who thinks logically, works methodically, and is curious about what the data can tell you before anyone asks.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Be responsible for the data architecture — Design and manage how data is stored and organized in BigQuery, including schemas, partitioning, clustering, and DDLs.
* Build the data transformation layer — Convert raw data into clean, reliable, and tested data models using scheduled and version\-controlled pipelines.
* Define and maintain data metrics — Maintain clear data definitions and quality checks so teams get consistent and reliable answers from the data.
* Answer business questions with data\-backed insights — Work with Product and Operations teams to understand their requirements, analyze the data, validate the findings, and deliver meaningful insights with clear considerations. Provide data in required formats, such as Google Sheets and other business\-ready formats, based on team requirements.
* Build useful dashboards and reports — Create dashboards and self\-service data models that help teams find the information they need without depending on the data team for every request.
* Automate data work with AI agents — Build and improve AI\-powered tools such as a Data Copilot that can answer questions in plain English, along with agents for dashboard building and routine data engineering tasks, with the right controls and safeguards.
* Be responsible for data costs — Optimize BigQuery queries and data structures to reduce unnecessary data processing and keep costs predictable.
* Follow data security and governance standards — Handle confidential and sensitive data responsibly and ensure all data processes follow security and governance requirements.
* Build and mentor the data team — As the data function grows, hire, onboard, and mentor data engineers while setting clear standards and best practices for the team.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Systematic and organized — You work in a systematic and organized way, while keeping the broader business and system context in view.
* Logical and structured thinking — You use logic to break complex problems into clear and manageable parts, identify the key issues, and arrive at practical solutions.
* Adaptable \& flexible — you adjust fast to changing requirements, new tools and shifting priorities.
* Clear communication — you ask the right questions and can disagree with a reason.
* Attention to Detail \& Ownership — You maintain a strong focus on data accuracy and quality while taking ownership of tasks and driving them through to successful completion.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* 1\-2 years in analytics engineering or data engineering — Production systems you can explain in detail: what you built, why you structured it that way, and what you would change.
* Advanced SQL on Google BigQuery, including DDL — Hands\-on BigQuery specifically, not transferable SQL.
* Data modelling — Dimensional or equivalent modelling in dbt or a similar framework, with testing, version control, and a view on when to denormalise.
* BI and semantic modelling — Hands\-on delivery in Looker Studio, Power BI, or equivalent, including the model behind the dashboard.
* Applied AI — Practical experience working with LLM APIs or AI agent frameworks, with a strong focus on grounding AI outputs and verifying the accuracy of what the model returns.
* Python — For pipeline automation, transformation, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
* Data formats — Strong Google Sheets skills, plus working knowledge of CSV and JSON.
* Must be a Graduate from Top 100 NIRF colleges — as per the NIRF 2025 Engineering Rankings
 
 .

title: Junior Systems & Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Junior Systems \& Network Engineer**

**Position:** Junior Systems \& Network Engineer  
**Department:** IT / Infrastructure  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
**Location:** Mumbai \& Ahmedabad  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Junior Systems \& Network Engineer** to support the day\-to\-day IT infrastructure requirements of the office.

The candidate will be responsible for checking and troubleshooting basic **system, hardware and network\-related issues**, managing IT assets, and coordinating with the **DevOps team, IT repair/service personnel and external vendors** whenever required.

This is a hands\-on junior\-level role suitable for someone who has basic knowledge of computer systems and networking and is willing to learn and take ownership of day\-to\-day IT requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Systems \& Hardware**

* Check and troubleshoot basic desktop, laptop, printer and other hardware\-related issues.
* Identify system and hardware problems and coordinate with the concerned IT repair/service person for resolution.
* Assist employees with basic system\-related issues.
* Coordinate installation, replacement, repair and maintenance of IT equipment.
* Ensure systems and peripherals are functioning properly.

**Network \& Internet**

* Monitor day\-to\-day office internet and network connectivity.
* Check and troubleshoot basic LAN/Wi\-Fi/network\-related issues.
* Identify network problems and coordinate with the internet/network service provider when required.
* Coordinate with the DevOps team for technical/network\-related issues that require further support.
* Ensure network\-related complaints are followed up until resolution.

**IT Asset Management**

* Maintain and regularly update the company's IT asset records.
* Track laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, networking equipment and other IT assets.
* Maintain records of asset allocation, transfers, repairs, replacements and returns.
* Ensure proper tagging and documentation of IT assets.
* Coordinate for repair/replacement of damaged or faulty equipment.

**Coordination \& Support**

* Act as the first point of contact for day\-to\-day **system, hardware and network\-related issues** at the office.
* Coordinate with the internal **DevOps team** for infrastructure/network\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the designated IT repair/service person for hardware repairs.
* Coordinate with external vendors, internet service providers and AMC/service providers as required.
* Maintain a record of IT issues, actions taken and their resolution status.

**Routine IT Checks**

* Conduct regular checks of office systems, network connectivity and IT equipment.
* Report any recurring or potential IT issues to the concerned team.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on pending repairs and technical issues.
* Assist the senior/DevOps team with basic IT infrastructure requirements whenever required.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **computer hardware and troubleshooting**
* Basic understanding of **networking, LAN, Wi\-Fi and internet connectivity**
* Basic knowledge of **IP addresses, routers, switches and network troubleshooting**
* Good understanding of Windows, Linux systems/servers and common desktop applications used in organization's. Basic knowledge of IT asset management.
* Azure cloud knowledge or certification is an advantage
* Hardware firewall knowledge must required.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Ability to independently handle routine office IT issues and escalate complex issues appropriately

**Qualification**

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in **IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related field**
* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge can also be considered.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on, responsible and technically inclined person** who can take care of the company's day\-to\-day systems, hardware and network requirements.

The candidate is **not expected to independently manage advanced servers or complex infrastructure**. They will primarily identify and handle basic issues and coordinate with the **DevOps team, IT repair person and external vendors** for technical issues requiring specialized support.

title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer – Engineering
description:
**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India / Gurgaon, India (On\-site)
   

  

**Shift:** 
 Normal or Night — depending on candidate preference and business need
 **Reports to:** 
 Lead DevOps / SRE
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About Practice By Numbers**
 Practice by Numbers (PbN) is a fast\-growing SaaS platform helping healthcare organizations leverage data, automation, patient engagement, and operational intelligence to improve business performance and patient outcomes. We build highly scalable cloud\-native products serving thousands of customers across North America.
   

  

 We are looking for a DevOps/SRE Engineer who writes Terraform and CI/CD pipelines. This is a builder’s role, not a monitoring seat.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 You will own Terraform modules across our AWS infrastructure — compute, networking, databases, IAM, DNS — and build the GitHub Actions pipelines that ship our Django, Python, Node.js, and React services.
   

  

 This role can be staffed on a normal shift or a night shift, depending on your preference and our coverage needs. On a night shift you get an uninterrupted window for the changes that are hardest to make in daylight — database migrations, pipeline rewrites, provider upgrades, and staged cutovers — and you will often be the only engineer on shift. That means real autonomy, real ownership, and the expectation that you can reason through an unfamiliar system on your own and write up clearly what you did.
   

  

 This role suits someone who wants deep infrastructure work with production ownership and prefers building over ticket\-shuffling.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure as Code**
* Own and extend Terraform modules across AWS — ECS/Fargate or EKS, RDS, VPC networking, IAM, ALB/NLB, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch.
* Manage Terraform state safely; write and review plans that reviewers can trust.
* Eliminate manually created resources by bringing them under code (via terraform import, refactors, and module extraction).
* Keep environments (dev, QA, production) consistent and reproducible.


**CI/CD Engineering**
* Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for build, test, containerization, and deployment.
* Migrate legacy pipelines (Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI) onto a single, maintainable platform.
* Design safe deployment paths — staged rollouts, health\-gated releases, fast and reliable rollback. Keep pipelines fast: caching, parallelism, test splitting, and honest gating.


**Reliability \& Operations**
* Own the production change window on your shift: deploys, migrations, cutovers, and maintenance.
* Run and improve observability — dashboards, SLOs, alerting that fires on real user impact rather than noise.
* Debug containerized applications in production: logs, metrics, traces, resource limits, networking.
* Participate in on\-call rotation and incident response; drive blameless post\-incident reviews. Improve cost efficiency and resource utilization across the AWS footprint.


**Databases \& Data Services**
* Operate PostgreSQL in production — read query plans, identify slow queries, understand connections, locks, and replication.
* Plan and execute schema migrations against live systems with minimal disruption.
* Operate supporting data services: Redis/ElastiCache, message brokers, object storage.


**Automation \& Tooling**
* Write Python and shell automation to remove repetitive operational work.
* Build tooling that makes the wider team faster — self\-service scripts, runbooks, guardrails.
* Harden secrets handling, access control, and infrastructure security posture.


**Handover \& Communication**
* Write clear, complete handover notes at the end of every shift. Where shifts do not overlap, your writing is how the rest of the team learns what happened.
* Maintain runbooks and infrastructure documentation as systems change.
* Coordinate with the wider engineering team on planned work and follow\-ups.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Use modern AI tools to accelerate infrastructure work, scripting, and troubleshooting.
* Apply AI\-assisted practices while maintaining strong engineering, security, and review standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 6\+ years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or Infrastructure engineering with genuine production ownership.
* Strong AWS experience — container orchestration (ECS/Fargate or EKS), RDS, VPC networking, IAM, load balancing, S3, CloudWatch.
* Hands\-on Terraform: writing modules, managing state, reviewing plans.
* Practical CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions. GitLab CI, CircleCI, or Jenkins backgrounds are fine if you can migrate.
* Docker, and comfort debugging containerized applications in production.
* Solid Linux fundamentals and shell scripting; Python for automation.
* Working PostgreSQL knowledge — query plans, slow queries, connections, locks, replication. Experience deploying and operating Django/Python and Node.js/React applications. Hands\-on use of an observability platform in anger (New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar).
* Clear written English. Your handover notes are how the rest of the team learns what happened. Openness to either a normal or a night shift, and willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation.


**Technical Expertise**
**Cloud \& Infrastructure**
* AWS (ECS / Fargate / EKS, EC2, Lambda)
* VPC, Subnets, Security Groups, NAT, Peering
* ALB / NLB, Route 53, CloudFront
* IAM, Roles, Policies, Least\-Privilege Design
* RDS, ElastiCache, S3
* Terraform / Infrastructure as Code


**CI/CD \& Automation**
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins / CircleCI / GitLab CI
* Docker, Container Registries
* Blue\-Green \& Staged Deployments, Rollback Strategies
* Python, Bash / Shell Scripting
* Git and Trunk\-Based Workflows


**Observability \& Reliability**
* New Relic / Datadog / Grafana / Prometheus
* CloudWatch Metrics, Logs, Alarms
* OpenTelemetry
* SLOs, Error Budgets, Alert Design
* Incident Management \& Post\-Incident Review


**Data \& Messaging**
* PostgreSQL Administration \& Tuning
* Schema Migrations on Live Systems
* Redis / ElastiCache
* Kafka / Redpanda / Amazon MSK, RabbitMQ, NATS


**Security \& Compliance**
* Secrets Management (AWS Secrets Manager, SOPS, Vault)
* Network and Access Hardening
* Vulnerability and Patch Management
* Audit Logging


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Celery, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Kafka in production.
* Redis / ElastiCache operations.
* Secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, SOPS, Vault).
* Experience with sharded or multi\-tenant database architectures.
* Healthcare or other compliance\-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Telephony / VoIP infrastructure exposure.
* Kubernetes.
* Prior experience as the sole engineer on shift, or on a night/off\-hours rotation.


**What We Look For**
* A builder’s instinct — you would rather codify a fix than repeat it.
* Comfort with autonomy and sound judgment on when to escalate.
* Careful, methodical change management on production systems.
* Strong written communication; your handover notes are a first\-class deliverable.
* Curiosity about how systems actually behave, not just how they are supposed to. Ownership, follow\-through, and continuous learning.


**Why This Role**
* Real ownership of infrastructure, not a ticket queue.
* Flexibility on shift, and a protected change window for high\-impact work.
* Modern stack: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, PostgreSQL, Kafka\-compatible messaging.
* Direct impact on the reliability of a platform used by thousands of healthcare practices.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer – Engineering
description:
**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India / Gurgaon, India (On\-site)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Head of Engineering / Security Lead
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About Practice By Numbers**
 Practice by Numbers (PbN) is a fast\-growing SaaS platform helping healthcare organizations leverage data, automation, patient engagement, and operational intelligence to improve business performance and patient outcomes. We build highly scalable cloud\-native products serving thousands of customers across North America.
   

  

 We handle protected health information at scale. Security is not a compliance checkbox for us — it is a product requirement. We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer who can secure a live, fast\-moving cloud platform hands\-on.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will own the security posture of our AWS cloud infrastructure and our Python/Django, FastAPI, Node.js, and React applications. You will find real vulnerabilities, fix them or drive them to closure, and build the controls and automation that stop the same class of issue from recurring.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, technical role. You will read code, review architecture, run tests against our own systems, tune detections, respond to incidents, and carry the technical side of our HIPAA and SOC 2 obligations. You will work directly with engineering rather than filing findings over a wall.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has genuine application and cloud security depth, understands how software is actually built and deployed, and can tell a real risk from a scanner artifact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Security**
* Perform secure code reviews across Python/Django/FastAPI, Node.js, and React/TypeScript codebases.
* Threat model new features and services; identify design\-level risks before they ship. Own SAST, DAST, dependency, secret, and container scanning — including triage, false\-positive reduction, and driving fixes to closure.
* Run white\-box (source\-assisted), grey\-box (authenticated, partial\-knowledge), and black\-box (external, zero\-knowledge) security testing against our own applications and APIs.
* Test authentication, authorization, multi\-tenant isolation, and session handling; hunt for IDOR, privilege escalation, and tenant data leakage.
* Review API security: input validation, rate limiting, authorization enforcement, and data exposure. Define and maintain secure coding standards; coach engineers through review rather than mandate.


**Cloud \& Infrastructure Security**
* Harden AWS infrastructure — IAM least privilege, VPC and network segmentation, security groups, encryption at rest and in transit, S3 and RDS controls.
* Review Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code for security defects; add policy\-as\-code guardrails. Secure containerized workloads (Docker, ECS/Fargate or EKS) — image hygiene, runtime configuration, secrets handling.
* Own secrets management practices (AWS Secrets Manager, SOPS, Vault) and key rotation. Continuously audit cloud configuration drift and remediate exposure.


**Security Operations \& Incident Response**
* Build and tune detection and alerting across cloud, application, and access logs. Investigate security alerts; separate real signal from noise.
* Lead incident response — containment, forensics, root cause, and blameless post\-incident review. Maintain and exercise the incident response plan, including breach\-notification readiness. Run vulnerability management end to end: discovery, risk\-based prioritization, SLA tracking, verification.


**Compliance \& Governance (Technical Ownership)**
* Own the engineering side of HIPAA and SOC 2 — implement controls, produce evidence, and support audits.
* Maintain audit logging, access review, data retention, and encryption controls. Support security questionnaires, customer security reviews, and third\-party/vendor assessments. Coordinate external penetration tests and drive remediation of findings.
* Keep security policies and technical documentation accurate as systems change.


**Security Engineering \& Automation**
* Embed security checks into CI/CD (GitHub Actions) so issues surface at pull\-request time. Write Python and shell automation for evidence collection, configuration auditing, and remediation.
* Build tooling and guardrails that make the secure path the easy path for engineers. Improve identity and access management across cloud, SaaS, and internal tooling.


**Collaboration \& Enablement**
* Partner with engineering, DevOps, and product teams as an embedded security reviewer. Run practical security training and awareness for engineering.
* Communicate risk clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, with a recommendation attached.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Use modern AI tools to accelerate code review, detection engineering, and analysis.
* Apply AI\-assisted practices while maintaining rigorous verification, data\-handling, and review standards.
* Assess and secure the organization’s own use of AI services, including data\-exposure risk.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline. 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with substantial application security or cloud security ownership. Strong AWS security experience — IAM, VPC networking, encryption, logging, and common misconfiguration patterns.
* Ability to read and reason about production code; Python strongly preferred, plus JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands\-on web application and API security testing (OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10\) using black\-box, grey\-box, and white\-box approaches.
* Ability to write up findings with reproducible steps, impact, severity rationale, and a concrete remediation path.
* Practical experience with SAST/DAST/SCA and container scanning tooling, including triage and remediation.
* Working knowledge of Docker and container orchestration (ECS/Fargate or EKS). Experience with vulnerability management and incident response in production environments. Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, or equivalent compliance frameworks.
* Solid Linux fundamentals, networking, and cryptography basics.
* Clear written and verbal English; ability to document findings and risk decisions precisely.


**Technical Expertise**
**Application Security**
* Secure Code Review (Python / Django / FastAPI, Node.js, React / TypeScript) Threat Modeling (STRIDE or equivalent)
* OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Security Top 10
* Authentication, Authorization, Multi\-Tenant Isolation
* Black\-Box / Grey\-Box / White\-Box Penetration Testing
* Manual Exploitation and Proof\-of\-Concept Development
* SAST / DAST / SCA, Secret and Dependency Scanning
* Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Semgrep, Trivy, and similar tooling


**Cloud \& Infrastructure Security**
* AWS IAM, VPC, Security Groups, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config ECS / Fargate / EKS Workload Security
* Terraform Security Review, Policy as Code (OPA, Checkov, tfsec)
* Secrets Management (AWS Secrets Manager, SOPS, Vault)
* Network Segmentation and Perimeter Controls


**Security Operations**
* SIEM / Log Analytics and Detection Engineering
* Incident Response and Digital Forensics
* Vulnerability Management and Risk\-Based Prioritization
* Audit Logging, Access Review, Monitoring and Alerting


**Data Protection \& Compliance**
* Encryption at Rest and in Transit, Key Management
* PHI / PII Handling, Data Classification, Retention
* HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, NIST CSF, ISO 27001
* Vendor and Third\-Party Risk Assessment


**Platform Context**
* PostgreSQL Security and Access Control
* Kafka / Redpanda / Amazon MSK, Redis
* GitHub Actions and CI/CD Security
* Python and Shell Automation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Security certifications — OSCP, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, GIAC (GWAPT, GCIH, GCSA), or CEH.
* Experience securing multi\-tenant SaaS platforms and tenant\-isolation models. Prior experience carrying a SOC 2 Type II audit or HIPAA program through to completion. Offensive security background — black\-box penetration testing, red teaming, or bug bounty experience.
* Experience scoping and managing third\-party black\-box or grey\-box penetration tests. Kubernetes security.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and message\-broker security.
* Detection\-as\-code and security automation at scale.
* Exposure to healthcare technology or other regulated domains.
* Experience securing AI/LLM\-integrated applications.


**What We Look For**
* Genuine hands\-on depth — you find real issues, not just scanner output.
* Engineering mindset: you fix and automate rather than only report.
* Sound risk judgment and the ability to prioritize what actually matters.
* Strong collaboration; engineers should want your review, not dread it.
* Precise written communication and clean documentation.
* Integrity, discretion, and ownership when handling sensitive data.
* Continuous learning as the threat landscape moves.


**Why This Role**
* Security ownership of a healthcare platform where the stakes are real.
* Breadth across application, cloud, and operational security in one role.
* Modern stack: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, Python, React, PostgreSQL, Kafka compatible messaging.
* Direct influence on architecture and engineering practice, not a downstream audit function.

title: IP Admin Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

 **Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

  

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

  

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

  

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

 **About the Team**

  

The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

 **Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (9 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

description:

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)

**Agra**

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Business Development and Sales
description:
**Company:** The Lumos IQ  
**Work Type:** Remote / Flexible  
**Compensation:** Commission\-Based  
**Primary Services:** Meta Ads \& Social Media Marketing

About The Lumos IQ

The Lumos IQ is a growth\-focused marketing agency helping businesses grow through paid advertising, social media, stronger online visibility, creative strategy, and digital growth solutions.

We are looking for a **Business Development Executive (BDE)** who can identify potential clients, approach decision\-makers, pitch our services, close deals, and maintain long\-term relationships with onboarded clients.

Key Responsibilities

* Find potential clients through LinkedIn, cold calling, WhatsApp, email, and other outreach channels.
* Start conversations with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Understand the prospect's business and marketing requirements.
* Pitch our services and packages according to their requirements.
* Handle objections, negotiations, follow\-ups, and client closing.
* Coordinate client onboarding with our internal team.
* Stay connected with onboarded clients and proactively check their satisfaction.
* Help convert pilot clients into our standard monthly packages.
* Identify upselling opportunities for additional services.
* Maintain records of prospects, follow\-ups, meetings, and conversions.

Client Pricing Structure

**Month 1 – Pilot Package: ₹5,000**

The first month is offered as a low\-risk pilot to make it easier for new businesses to start working with us.

The BD must clearly inform the client before onboarding that this is an introductory price for the first month only.

**Month 2 Onwards – Standard Package: ₹15,000/month**

From the second month, the standard fee becomes ₹15,000 per month.

This package includes Meta Ads management along with basic social media support to keep the client's social presence active.

**Full Social Media \+ Ads Package: ₹25,000/month**

If the client requires complete social media management, including content planning, creatives, reels, regular posting, and Meta Ads management, the BD can pitch our ₹25,000/month package.

Commission Structure

**Month 1:**  
Client pays ₹5,000\.  
BD receives a **flat ₹1,000 bonus** after successful paid onboarding.

**Month 2:**  
Client pays ₹15,000\.  
BD receives **15% commission – ₹2,250\.**

**Month 3:**  
Client pays ₹15,000\.  
BD receives **10% commission – ₹1,500\.**

**Month 4:**  
Client pays ₹15,000\.  
BD receives **7% commission – ₹1,050\.**

**Month 5 onwards:**  
BD receives **5% recurring commission – ₹750/month** on a ₹15,000 client for as long as the client remains active and continues paying the agency.

This structure is designed to reward both **client acquisition and long\-term client retention.**

What We're Looking For

* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Confidence in speaking with business owners and decision\-makers
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills
* Ability to independently find and approach prospects
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and Meta Ads is preferred
* Consistent and disciplined approach towards outreach
* Ability to build and maintain professional client relationships

Previous experience in **Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, or Digital Marketing** is preferred.

**Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may also apply.**

Important

This is not just a client\-closing role.

The Business Development Executive will be involved in the client journey from **prospecting → pitching → closing → onboarding → relationship management → retention → upselling.**

Our objective is to build long\-term partnerships with clients, and therefore the commission structure rewards BDs who bring good clients and help maintain those relationships over time.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

title: Network Developer 2
description:
**Job Description**
 Designs and develops network systems for small and large\-scale enterprise, data center, or cloud\-based environments independently, collaborating with vendors and internal groups to validate configurations. Contributes business logic to automation frameworks for testing and operations independently, automating network tasks and reviewing dashboards to monitor network health. Independently develops and implements test cases and strategies, guiding junior engineers, conducting break\-fix validation, and gathering and innovating compliance data collection. Implements and defines requirements for monitoring network health using dashboards and alerting systems, conducts incident response and root cause investigations, and develops tools for frontline support teams. Collaborates with project managers to achieve milestones, guides junior engineers, contributes to incident response and RCA documentation, and ensures networking standards adherence independently. Analyzes network performance metrics to identify efficiency issues and supports infrastructure growth with guidance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Network Design, Development, and Validation:**
* Designs and develops standard network systems to support small and large\-scale enterprise, data center, or cloud\-based networking environments independently.
* Validates production networks and assists in scaling use cases independently.
* Participates in the network solution design and validation process independently.
* Identifies risks in network design prior to deployment.
* Collaborates with vendors and internal groups (e.g., quality assurance) to validate network configurations, hardware, firmware, software, and cloud network code.
* Contributes to the design of playbooks to support standard changes or investigations for common issues related to network areas.
* Implements guided improvements to the optimization of network processes to improve efficiency.


**Automation and Scripting:**
* Contributes business logic to automation frameworks for testing and operations to enhance efficiency.
* Automates network tasks, including production and lab environments and repetitive support functions independently.
* Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health.
* Writes moderately advanced scripts to automate routine tasks for the immediate team and other business units, independently.
* Uses infrastructure pipelines, configuration items, using established playbooks and resources.
* Adapts and configures tools with guidance to support specific aspects of new product functionality.


**Testing and Quality Assurance:**
* Develops and implements standalone test cases and test strategies independently.
* Provides expertise in test practices and strategies, guiding junior engineers in developing robust testing protocols.
* Provides break\-fix validation support and conducts post\-event root cause analysis (RCA) to address issues.
* Conducts L1 network change reviews and communicates network changes to others in preparation for change management review boards.
* Runs tests and verifies that systems meet defined compliance and readiness criteria, under supervision.
* Gathers Government, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) data following playbook and begins to innovate scripts to streamline data collection.


**Monitoring and Reliability:**
* Interprets advanced metrics across dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health, including defining metrics, trends, and thresholds to ensure service level objectives (SLOs).
* Implements monitoring and alerting systems for detecting and diagnosing network anomalies.
* Serves in operational support rotations by providing incident response and conducting root cause investigations, seeking assistance as needed to resolve escalated technical issues.
* Implements tools and solutions for frontline support teams to respond to network failure conditions.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration and Leadership:**
* Collaborates with project/program managers to achieve test and deployment milestones.
* Provides guidance to junior engineers and acts as a subject matter expert (SME) for routine issues.
* Engages with customer and contributes to the delivery of incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Participates in discussions on roadmap and software architecture design, providing feedback on ideas from junior team members.
* Collaborates with vendors and internal teams to ensure adherence to networking standards adherence, independently.


**Performance and Capacity Management:**
* Analyzes network performance and service metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify network efficiency issues, with support from other team members on next steps.
* Uses capacity information through security and performance metrics to ensure the infrastructure can support anticipated growth, requesting guidance from others on steps forward.


**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning \& Execution:**
* Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.


**Collaboration \& Partnership:**
* Collaborates within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.


**Problem Solving:**
* Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non\-standard errors.


**Continuous Learning:**
* Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.


**Continuous Improvement:**
* Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC2
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
