title: Junior Software Engineer - Remote
description:
\*
 ***This position is open to applicants from all countries***




  





**About Ambitus** 




 Ambitus is an applied AI product and research company that partners with domain experts and enterprises to advance frontier AI capabilities.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are working to build the future of AI for software engineering by pushing the boundaries of what frontier coding systems can achieve. In this role you will work hands\-on inside real, actively maintained open\-source codebases. You will turn written feature requests into working implementations, write automated tests to prove it works, and specify features precisely enough that another engineer could build them. The work spans across coding languages and ecosystems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Implement new features in established open\-source repositories (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust) from a written specification, following the project's existing architecture, conventions, and test suite.
* Write thorough automated tests for features that check observable behavior, cover edge cases and error paths, and run deterministically (no network access, no timing\-dependent assertions).
* Write feature specifications where every sentence is a testable claim: exact defaults, exact error messages, ordering guarantees, and edge\-case rules.
* Review an implementation and a test suite written from the same specification, find where they disagree, and determine which side is wrong and what must change.
* Make a fresh clone of a repository, install dependencies, run the project's native toolchain (npm/pnpm with vitest or jest, go test, pytest, cargo), and reproduce that setup in a Docker container.
* Use git the way a maintainer would: feature branches, clean commits with everything committed, and comfort reading a project's history to understand why the code is the way it is.
* Write clear, structured technical notes and feedback that a fellow engineer could act on without further explanation.



  





**Qualifications** 



* At least one year of professional experience building software, through employment, internships, or substantial open\-source or independent projects.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Read, trace, and reason about unfamiliar code in medium\-to\-large codebases (tens of thousands of lines) across multiple languages, and match the existing style when you change it.
* Strong in at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js), Python, or Go, and able to become productive in a second one quickly. Rust is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with standard test runners (vitest or jest, pytest, go test) and a working understanding of unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Understanding of how to write a test that fails before a change and passes after it, and how to tell when a test is asserting more than the requirement actually says.
* Comfort with the command line, git, and Docker basics (writing or adapting a Dockerfile, running a project inside a container).
* Precise written technical English.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Contributions to open\-source projects, or a project of your own that others use.
* Experience with additional ecosystems and runners (Rust/cargo, mocha, Deno) or with CI systems and machine\-readable test reports (JUnit XML).



  





**Application process** 




 Apply on our site. The hiring team reviews resumes/written responses and invites candidates to complete a short practical exercise: implement a small feature in an unfamiliar repository and write its tests. Offers are given to selected candidates.

title: Software Engineer (Plugin & Library Development)
description:
**Software Engineer II (Plugin and Library Development)** 




 Location \- Hyderabad
 



  





**About Us** 




 Liquidnitro Games is India’s flagship live services and game production company, founded
 



 by industry veterans with a proven track record in producing massively successful games \&
 



 live services. For game companies, studios and publishers worldwide – we offer world class
 



 game development expertise to power creativity, growth and profitability in their games.
 



  





**What’s in it?** 




 We’re looking for a highly talented and dedicated Software Engineer/Programmer who is
 



 passionate about developing software systems for games. As a software engineer you will
 



 be building the plugins, SDKs and shared libraries that our Unity and Unreal projects are
 



 built on, working in small teams that work closely together to create reusable, well
 



 documented solutions that other engineers depend on every day. You will work closely with
 



 the engineering lead to plan and streamline how these libraries are built and rolled out, and
 



 will provide technical expertise, establishing best practices, and driving innovation within the
 



 team.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Collaboratively working with other developers, artists, designers and the rest of the team to deliver well\-architected and high\-quality cross\-platform mobile solutions.
* Design, build and maintain reusable plugins, SDKs and libraries for Unity and/or Unreal, including the native Android and iOS layers behind them.
* Own the public API surface of what you ship — versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation paths and upgrade guides for the teams consuming it.
* Package and distribute libraries through UPM, .unitypackage or Unreal plugin formats, and keep them building cleanly across the engine versions our projects use.
* Diagnose and resolve the problems specific to library work: dependency and symbol conflicts, engine and OS version fragmentation, build and link failures, and lifecycle or threading mismatches between engine and native code.
* Write and maintain sample projects, integration documentation and automated tests so teams can adopt your libraries without hand\-holding.
* Collaborate closely with the cross functional game development teams to execute on the roadmap/vision of our games.
* Estimate engineering effort during multiple stages of product life cycle.
* Responsible for end\-to\-end development architecture, thus ensuring the code written to implement the architecture and design meets the highest standards regarding code quality and efficiency.
* Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques, and evaluate their potential application in the game development process.
* Take part in regular code and design reviews to maintain consistency across the project.
* Work closely with the engineering lead to scope, sequence and streamline library development, and to keep what you build aligned with the needs of the consuming project teams.
* Actively use and refine AI\-assisted workflows — code generation, review, test authoring, documentation and tooling — and share what demonstrably works with the team.



  





**Plugin \& Library Development:** 




 This role exists because libraries fail in ways that game code does not. We want someone
 



 who has already run into these problems and has opinions about them:
 


* Designing a small, clean API surface and keeping it stable as the number of consumers grows.
* Semantic versioning and managing breaking changes across multiple live projects sitting on different engine versions.
* Native interop — JNI and Objective\-C/Swift bridging, marshalling, and memory ownership across the managed/native boundary.
* Dependency and transitive dependency conflicts: Gradle/AAR collisions, duplicate symbols, CocoaPods and Swift Package version pinning.
* Build system integration: Gradle templates, Xcode post\-process build steps, Unreal .Build.cs and .uplugin configuration.
* Threading and lifecycle correctness — main\-thread marshalling, application pause/resume, and background callbacks re\-entering managed code.
* Debugging failures inside a consumer’s project that you cannot reproduce locally: logging strategy, symbolication and crash triage.
* Binary size, startup cost, and the implications of code stripping, IL2CPP or equivalent on what you ship.
* Keeping up with editor tooling changes and first\-party SDK and policy churn without breaking downstream projects.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in game/application development for mobile platforms (Android and iOS) using Unity and/or Unreal.
* Demonstrable experience building and shipping plugins, SDKs or shared libraries that were consumed by other teams or external partners.
* Strong C\+\+ and C\# skills, with solid architectural and software engineering fundamentals.
* Hands\-on native platform development in at least one of Android (Java/Kotlin, JNI, Gradle) or iOS (Objective\-C/Swift, Xcode build phases, CocoaPods).
* Knowledge of common data structures and algorithmic solutions.
* Experience with profiling and debugging mobile applications.
* Understanding of Crashlytics and Google Play console.
* Understanding of mobile application development guidelines defined by first parties (Apple and Google).
* Familiarity with source control, CI and automated build pipelines for producing and publishing library artifacts.
* Excellent written, verbal communication skills and critical thinking skills — for this role, documentation is part of the deliverable.
* A genuine passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry.
* Demonstrated interest or hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development workflows (Copilot, Claude, Cursor or similar), and the ability to adapt AI tools into day\-to\-day workflows to improve productivity — including judgement about where they help, where they do not, and how to review their output critically.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Shipped titles live on Android or iOS.
* Gameplay systems experience — Finite State Machines, Behaviour Trees, animation or physics integration.
* Editor tooling: custom inspectors, importers or build automation in Unity or Unreal.
* Rendering awareness — shaders, batching, draw call and overdraw budgets.
* Integrating third\-party game SDKs such as analytics, ads, IAP or attribution.
* Performance work on low\-end devices: memory budgets, GC pressure and frame pacing.
* Open\-source contributions or a published package used by others.

**Company:** Meritzee EdTech  
**Position:** Sales Executive – Inside Sales \& Field Sales (Lead Generation, Cold Calling, Webinars \& Sales Closure)  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Location:** Banglore (Field \+ Office/Hybrid)  
**Experience:** 1–3 years (Freshers with excellent communication can also apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About Meritzee

Meritzee is an EdTech company building a tutor/learning app that connects students with quality educators and courses. We are looking for driven, target\-oriented Sales Executives who can generate leads, run engaging webinars, and close admissions/sales through both tele\-calling and field visits.

Role Summary

The Sales Executive will be responsible for the end\-to\-end sales cycle — from lead generation and cold calling to conducting webinars/demo sessions, handling field sales visits, and closing enrollments/subscriptions for the Meritzee tutor app.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting**

* Generate new leads through cold calling, database calling, social media, referrals, and campus/community outreach.
* Identify potential customers (students/parents/institutions) interested in tutoring/learning solutions.
* Maintain and update lead pipeline in CRM daily.

**2\. Cold Calling \& Tele\-Sales**

* Make outbound calls to prospective leads to explain Meritzee's app, courses, and offerings.
* Qualify leads based on interest, need, and budget.
* Schedule counseling calls, demo sessions, or webinar attendance for interested prospects.
* Follow up consistently with warm/cold leads to nurture them toward conversion.

**3\. Webinar \& Event Management**

* Plan, coordinate, and conduct online webinars/demo sessions to showcase the app/courses to prospective students and parents.
* Present course value proposition, pricing, and offers persuasively during webinars.
* Organize and represent Meritzee at offline events, seminars, school/college tie\-ups, and education fairs.
* Handle audience Q\&A and objection handling live during sessions.

**4\. Sales Conversion \& Closing**

* Convert leads generated through calls, webinars, and events into paid enrollments/subscriptions.
* Handle pricing negotiations, offer explanations, and payment processing.
* Achieve individual and team sales/revenue targets on a weekly/monthly basis.
* Follow structured sales pitch and objection\-handling frameworks provided by the company.

**5\. Field Sales**

* Conduct in\-person meetings with parents/students/institutions as required for high\-value closures.
* Visit schools, coaching centers, and local communities to build partnerships and generate walk\-in leads.
* Represent the brand professionally during field visits and local marketing activities.

**6\. Reporting \& CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, conversions, and follow\-ups in CRM/Excel.
* Share daily/weekly sales reports with the reporting manager.
* Provide market feedback and competitor insights to improve sales strategy.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills (Regional language \+ Hindi/English).
* Strong convincing and negotiation ability.
* Confidence in public speaking / webinar hosting.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, Excel, and calling software.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and comfortable with a fast\-paced sales environment.
* Willingness to travel locally for field sales and events.
* Prior experience in EdTech/telesales/inside sales is a plus.

Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline (preferred: Business, Marketing, or Education\-related field).
* Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome; prior sales/tele\-calling experience preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of leads generated per day/week.
* Number of calls made and connect ratio.
* Webinar attendance\-to\-conversion ratio.
* Number of sales closures / revenue achieved vs. target.
* Field visit conversion rate.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary \+ attractive incentive/commission structure.
* Training on product, pitch, and sales tools.

description:
**Job Title: Warehouse \& Inventory Operator**

**Location:** Sector 28, Gurugram (Near MG Road Metro)

**Business Type:** Nutraceuticals \& OTC Healthcare Distribution

**1\. Role Summary**

The Warehouse Operator is the heart of our distribution cycle. You will be responsible for managing the flow of health supplements (Nutraceuticals) and Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) medicines. Your primary goal is to ensure that the right products are in stock, correctly stored, and accurately packed for our delivery team.

This role is perfect for **Fresh Graduates** who are detail\-oriented and looking to build a career in Supply Chain or Logistics within a professional and supportive environment.

**2\. Detailed Responsibilities**

* **Inward Stock Management:** \* Unloading incoming shipments from manufacturers.
* Verifying physical stock against the Purchase Invoice (checking quantities and expiry dates).
* Organizing stock on shelves using a "First\-In, First\-Out" (FIFO) system to ensure products don't expire.
* **Order Picking \& Packing:** \* Reading daily order sheets for various medical stores.
* Carefully picking the correct Nutraceutical and OTC items.
* Packing products securely to prevent damage during bike transit.
* **Inventory Accuracy:** \* Conducting weekly or monthly physical stock counts (Audit).
* Maintaining a clean, dry, and organized basement environment (Basement 2\) to protect medical\-grade products.
* **Team Collaboration:** \* Handing over packed boxes to the Delivery Executives by 9:30 AM daily.
* Reporting any low\-stock levels to the management immediately.

**3\. Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** **Graduate** in any stream (B.A., B.Com, B.Sc, etc.).
* **Experience:** None required (**Freshers are welcome**). We will teach you the basics of inventory software and stock handling.
* **Skills:** \* Basic computer knowledge (for data entry).
* Good organizational skills—you should be someone who likes keeping things in the "right place."
* Reliability and honesty are non\-negotiable.

**4\. Why Join Us?**

* **Friendly Management:** We believe in a stress\-free workplace. You will be treated with respect and given the help you need to succeed.
* **Career Growth:** As the business grows, you will have the opportunity to move into a Warehouse Manager or Operations Head role.
* **Stable Schedule:** No late nights. Our **9:00 AM – 6:00 PM** timing ensures you get home on time.
* **Fixed Off:** Every **Sunday** is a holiday.

title: Product Manager
description:
Allerin builds production AI for enterprises, agentic systems, computer vision, machine learning, and analytics that run in the real world and are measured on real numbers. Our engineering team ships systems like automated defect detection, license plate recognition, and AI\-driven analytics for
 



 manufacturing, logistics, retail, and public safety. When we publish a case study, it says things like "false positives down 85 percent", because our clients measure whether it works, and so do we.
 



  





 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of our AI products end to end, the problem, the users, the roadmap, and the release. This is a hands\-on product role at a company that runs several bets at once, so the product you own will evolve. What will not change is the nature of the work: hard,
 



 technical, and real.
 



  





 AI products fail differently from ordinary software. A model can be right 80 percent of the time while the client expects to go live next week. The judgment calls in that gap, what ships, what waits, what needs a guardrail, are the core of this job.
 



  





**What you will do** 





 \-
 
 Own an AI, ML, or computer\-vision product end to end: problem, users, roadmap, release
 




 \-
 
 Set the KPI a release has to move, and hold the gate when it does not clear it
 




 \-
 
 Write specs engineers trust, and reason credibly about architecture, cost, and latency
 




 \-
 
 Design for the failure modes, not just the demo: edge cases, false positives, the long tail
 




 \-
 
 Ship against evals and real metrics, and build the guardrails that make a demo enterprise\-ready
 




 \-
 
 Tie the work to numbers the business actually feels, and report honestly on what is on track
 



  





**What we look for** 





 \-
 
 The judgment to know what to build, and the honesty to kill your own idea when the data says so
 




 \-
 
 A real understanding that AI systems are probabilistic, not features that simply work or do not
 




 \-
 
 The habit of prototyping your own ideas with AI tools instead of delegating every question
 




 \-
 
 Plain, direct communication, especially when something is slipping
 



  





 We hire for ability, not years. A candidate with three years and something real to show beats a candidate with eight years and a title. We do not require certifications, and we read what you write more carefully than where you worked.
 



  





**What you get** 





 \-
 
 End\-to\-end ownership of a real AI product, with the authority that word implies
 




 \-
 
 Enterprise clients, production stakes, and problems that are genuinely hard
 




 \-
 
 A senior engineering team that judges ideas on evidence
 




 \-
 
 No two months that look the same
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Product management skills:** 
 experience owning product roadmap, requirements, and lifecycle for software or AI\-powered solutions.
* **Technical and data skills:** 
 understanding of AI/ML concepts, data analytics, and modern software development practices (experience with agentic systems, computer vision, or analytics is a plus).
* **Business and strategy skills:** 
 ability to define KPIs, evaluate trade\-offs, and align product decisions with measurable business outcomes.
* **Collaboration and communication skills:** 
 strong stakeholder management, clear written and verbal communication, and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* **User and market understanding:** 
 experience in customer research, requirements gathering, and translating user needs into product features.
* **Organizational skills:** 
 strong prioritization, time management, and comfort working in fast\-paced, iterative environments.
* **Education:** 
 bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; a master’s degree or MBA is an advantage.
* **Experience:** 
 prior product management experience in tech, SaaS, or AI\-focused companies; experience with enterprise clients or public agencies is beneficial.

Project Coordinator / Junior Project Manager – Role Profile Role Purpose The Project Coordinator / Junior Project Manager will support client communication and internal project execution by ensuring clear information flow, task coordination, and delivery alignment across stakeholders. This role is designed for early\-career professionals with strong communication and organizational skills who can take ownership of coordination responsibilities and grow into a full Project Manager role based on performance. title: Scrum Master Senior Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Job Role:** 
 Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
   

  

**About Cigna**
 Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.
   

  

 Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.
   

  

 We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.
   

  

 This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.
   

  

 The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Coaching and Agile Enablement
   

  

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.


 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.


 Facilitation and Cadence Events
   

  

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.


 ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments
   

  

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.


 Success in this Role
   

  

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.


**Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* At least 4 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, Kanban practices, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.
* Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.


**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.


**About The Cigna Group**
 Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: UX Designer
description:
*Practice by Numbers (PBN) \| Gurugram, India Scope: Product Design — Web App, Mobile \& Kiosk*
**About Practice By Numbers**
 Practice by Numbers is a dental practice management SaaS platform serving over 1,500 practices across North America — practice management software, VOIP, payment processing, analytics, and AI\-powered patient communication. Our users are dentists, front\-desk staff and office managers who live inside our product all day, under time pressure.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a UX Designer to own end\-to\-end product design — from problem framing and user flows through to high\-fidelity UI and developer handoff. This is a hands\-on IC role on a small design team: you will be the design presence in Gurugram, working directly with Product Managers and engineers here, and reporting to our Senior Designer in the US.
   

  

 You'll design across the platform: the AI Receptionist (voice and SMS patient conversations), Online Appointment Booking, Campaigns, Payments, PracticeIQ analytics, the new web app layout experience, and our mobile and front\-desk kiosk apps. Real workflows, real constraints — multi\-tenant software, dense data screens, and staff who need to complete a task in seconds, not minutes.
   

  

 Reports to: Senior Designer (US\-based)
   

  

 Location: Gurugram, India — this role is open in Gurugram only
   

  

 Work Mode: In\-office
   

  

 Working Hours: Primarily IST (10 AM – 5 PM), with some evening overlap with US teams (until 9–11 PM IST) as needed
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Design**
* Turn product requirements and user problems into flows, information architecture, wireframes and high\-fidelity UI in Figma
* Design for web, responsive web, mobile and kiosk — including empty, loading, error and permission states
* Prototype interactions to test and communicate intent before engineering builds it
* Design for existing screens as often as new ones — redesigns and incremental improvements are a large part of the work


**Discovery \& Validation**
* Talk to internal stakeholders (CX, support, sales) and end users to understand the workflow before designing it
* Run lightweight usability tests and design reviews; use findings to change the design, not to justify it
* Use product analytics and support tickets as inputs to design decisions


**System \& Handoff**
* Work within and contribute to our design system — components, patterns, tokens; flag and resolve inconsistencies
* Produce clear specs and handoff: states, responsive behaviour, edge cases, interaction details
* Review the built implementation against the design and close the gaps with engineering
* Apply accessibility fundamentals — contrast, hierarchy, keyboard and touch targets
* Use AI design tools alongwith legacy tools such as Figma, XD to get the designs implementation ready.


**Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Management from problem statement onward, surfacing edge cases early
* Participate in grooming, sprint planning and product reviews with distributed teams
* Present and defend design decisions with reasoning, and take critique from the Senior Designer and PMs well


**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of core UX design experience at an internet or software product company (B2B/B2C SaaS, consumer internet, or product\-led platforms)
* A portfolio you can walk us through — 2–3 case studies showing the problem, your process, the decisions you made, and the shipped outcome. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
* Experience designing products that shipped and that you saw through to release


**Skills**
* Strong command of Figma — components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, shared libraries
* Interaction design and information architecture fundamentals: hierarchy, layout, typography, states
* Ability to design within an existing design system rather than inventing per screen
* Comfortable designing data\-dense screens — tables, dashboards, filters, settings
* Clear written and verbal English; can explain a design decision to a US stakeholder without a meeting


**Attributes**
* Comfort with ambiguity — you can make a reasonable call and explain it
* Self\-directed; you drive your own work to completion without close supervision
* Comfortable with a fast pace, evolving requirements and a two\-releases\-a\-month cadence
* Willing to work in\-office in Gurugram and overlap with US hours when needed


**Preferred**
* Formal design education — B.Des / M.Des in Interaction, Communication or Product Design, or HCI
* B2B SaaS or multi\-tenant product experience
* Healthcare, fintech or other regulated\-domain products
* Experience with conversational or voice interfaces
* Contributed to building or maintaining a design system
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS — enough to know what is cheap and what is expensive to build
* Exposure to AI\-assisted design tooling in day\-to\-day work

title: Fraud & Risk Analyst
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Maya Mobile is one of the world's top 5 travel eSIM brands, trusted by 3\.5M\+ travelers across 190\+ countries to stay connected the moment they land. Our app makes it dead simple — pick your destination, tap to install, and you're online. No SIM swaps, no roaming bills, no hassle. Backed by our own mobile network infrastructure, we combine the reliability of a real carrier with the speed and simplicity travelers expect from a best\-in\-class consumer app. We're growing fast, scaling globally, and building the brand that travelers recommend to every friend before their next trip.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a sharp, curious, and data\-driven Fraud \& Risk Analyst to join our team and help protect Maya Mobile's revenue and customer trust. This is a foundational role — you'll be at the center of identifying, investigating, and preventing fraud across our transaction ecosystem, including payment processing, promotional vouchers and coupon codes, eSIM activation abuse, and usage anomalies. You'll work with large datasets, build detection frameworks, leverage AI\-powered tools to spot patterns humans can't, and help shape the fraud prevention best practices that will scale with our business. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is analytically rigorous, naturally skeptical, and excited about using modern tools — including AI and automation — to outsmart bad actors.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Fraud Detection \& Investigation**
* Monitor and investigate suspicious activity across payments, voucher redemptions, promotional code abuse, refund patterns, and eSIM activation/usage anomalies.
* Analyze transaction\-level data to identify fraud rings, synthetic identities, account takeover attempts, and policy exploitation.
* Investigate chargebacks and payment disputes, coordinating with payment processors (e.g., Adyen) and internal teams to resolve cases and recover revenue.
* 
* **Big Data Analysis \& AI\-Powered Detection**
* Work with large\-scale transaction and behavioral datasets to surface fraud signals and emerging attack vectors.
* Use AI and machine learning tools (e.g., anomaly detection models, LLM\-assisted pattern recognition, automated alerting) to improve detection speed and accuracy.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track fraud KPIs — loss rates, false positive rates, detection latency, and voucher/coupon abuse metrics.
* 
* **Best Practices \& Prevention Frameworks**
* Help develop and document fraud prevention best practices, standard operating procedures, and escalation workflows.
* Contribute to rule\-based and risk\-scoring frameworks for transaction approval, voucher issuance, and promotional campaign safeguards.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payments, and Marketing to embed fraud controls into new features, campaigns, and partner integrations before launch.
* Conduct post\-incident reviews and recommend systemic improvements.
* 
* **Reporting \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Prepare clear, concise fraud reports and case summaries for leadership review.
* Partner with the payments and finance teams on chargeback management, BIN attack response, and payment processor risk tooling (e.g., Adyen RevenueProtect).
* Stay current on emerging fraud trends in digital payments, eSIM/telecom, and e\-commerce.


- 


  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work comfortably with large datasets.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one data analysis tool or language (Python, R, Excel/Google Sheets at an advanced level).
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and enthusiasm for using AI\-powered tools (ChatGPT, Claude, custom models) to enhance fraud analysis workflows.
* Excellent attention to detail and a healthy sense of skepticism — you notice when numbers don't add up.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document findings and present them clearly.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Prior internship or project experience in fraud, risk, payments, or compliance.
* Exposure to payment processing platforms (Adyen, Stripe, Braintree) or chargeback management tools.
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with telecom, eSIM, or travel\-tech industries.
* Understanding of common fraud typologies: promo abuse, coupon stacking, card testing, friendly fraud, account farming.
* Experience building or working with rule engines, risk\-scoring systems, or anomaly detection pipelines.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Fully remote role — work from India or the Philippines.
* The opportunity to build fraud and risk infrastructure from the ground up at a high\-growth company.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and cross\-functional decision\-making.
* A fast\-paced, low\-bureaucracy culture where your work has immediate, measurable impact.
* Access to cutting\-edge AI and data tools to do your best work.



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Maya Mobile is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

 Available based on performance and suitability
 



**About Karagrey Media** 


 Karagrey Media is an execution\-first creative and digital growth agency focused on helping brands grow through strategic marketing, search engine optimization, performance marketing, social media, website development, branding, content, and creative solutions.
 





 Our larger mission is to
 
**build 1,000 brands and contribute to creating 1 million job opportunities** 

 by helping businesses grow.
 





 As we continue to build our team, we are looking for an
 
**HR Intern** 

 who wants hands\-on exposure to recruitment, employee operations, and people coordination in a growing digital marketing agency.
 



**About the Role** 


 As an HR Intern at Karagrey Media, you will work directly with the
 
**Founder and Co\-Founder** 

 and get practical exposure to multiple areas of HR.
 





 The role will primarily involve
 
**recruitment and candidate coordination** 

 , along with onboarding, employee records, attendance, internal coordination, employee engagement, and learning \& development.
 





 You will be working closely with a team of approximately
 
**15 people** 

 , giving you direct exposure to how HR functions within a growing organization.
 





 This role is suited to someone who is
 
**organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, responsive, persistent, and comfortable taking ownership of follow\-ups and coordination.** 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 
* Assist with hiring for intern and full\-time positions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Internshala, and other relevant platforms.
* Review resumes and identify relevant candidates.
* Conduct initial screening calls to assess basic role fit and communication.
* Coordinate candidate assignments and follow up on pending submissions.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with management.
* Communicate interview details and ensure candidates are informed and prepared.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Communicate selection, rejection, and other hiring updates professionally.
* Coordinate offer communication and follow up on offer acceptance.
* Confirm joining dates and follow up with selected candidates before joining.
* Inform management about candidate delays, drop\-offs, or no\-shows.


**Onboarding \& Joining** 
* Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees and interns.
* Send and follow up on required onboarding information and documents.
* Verify submitted information and documents for completeness.
* Coordinate required account and system access for new team members.
* Help new employees understand company policies and their role.
* Coordinate initial alignment and orientation activities.
* Ensure new team members complete the required onboarding steps.
* Maintain proper onboarding documentation and records.


**Employee Records \& Attendance** 
* Maintain accurate employee information and records.
* Track daily attendance and leave records.
* Keep employee information updated in case of joining, exit, drop\-off, or role changes.
* Maintain organized digital and physical HR documentation.
* Support management with accurate attendance and leave information required for payroll\-related processes.


**HR Operations \& Internal Coordination** 
* Support day\-to\-day HR operations and employee coordination.
* Follow up with employees and interns on pending HR requirements.
* Coordinate internal review meetings and related communication.
* Support the collection and organization of monthly employee reports.
* Maintain records of meetings, feedback, and follow\-up actions.
* Track pending HR\-related actions and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Escalate relevant employee or operational concerns to management.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates, employees, and management.


**Employee Engagement** 
* Help plan and coordinate structured team activities.
* Support festival\-based initiatives where applicable.
* Contribute to employee engagement and team morale.
* Ensure engagement activities are planned without affecting regular work output.


**Learning \& Development** 
* Identify and suggest relevant courses and learning resources for team members.
* Discuss learning recommendations with management before implementation.
* Maintain records of team learning activities.
* Track course selection, progress, and completion.
* Support initiatives that encourage continuous learning across the team.
* Continue developing your own HR and recruitment knowledge.


**What We’re Looking For** 


 We are looking for someone who is:
 



* Detail\-oriented and organized
* Disciplined and reliable
* Proactive with follow\-ups
* Persistent about completing tasks
* Responsive and approachable
* Comfortable communicating with candidates and employees
* Assertive when follow\-up or coordination is required
* Adaptable and open to feedback
* Comfortable working with data, documentation, and multiple ongoing activities
* Interested in building a career in HR and recruitment


**Skills That Will Help You Succeed** 
* Resume screening
* Candidate evaluation
* Candidate follow\-up
* Interview coordination
* Onboarding coordination
* HR record management
* HR data management
* Professional communication
* Stakeholder coordination
* Problem solving
* Active listening
* Feedback implementation


**Who Can Apply?** 
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Graduates from
 
**any discipline** 

 can apply.
* Candidates with prior HR internship or entry\-level experience may also apply.
* **English and Hindi communication skills are mandatory.**
* No specific gender requirement.




 A formal HR qualification is
 
**not mandatory** 

 . We value your ability to learn, communicate effectively, stay organized, and execute consistently.
 



**What You’ll Get** 
**Hands\-on Recruitment Exposure** 


 Work on real hiring requirements and gain practical experience across the recruitment process.
 



**Direct Exposure to Management** 


 Work directly with the Founder and Co\-Founder and gain exposure to decision\-making in a growing organization.
 



**Exposure to a Growing Digital Marketing Agency** 


 Understand how people and talent support a growing digital marketing business and work closely with a team of approximately 15 people.
 



**Exposure to Multiple HR Functions** 


 Gain practical exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee records, attendance, internal coordination, employee engagement, and learning \& development.
 



**Learning \& Development Exposure** 


 Work on learning initiatives for the team while continuously developing your own HR and recruitment capabilities.
 



**Structured Performance\-Based Growth** 


 Your growth and increased responsibilities will be based on your performance, learning, consistency, and ability to take ownership.
 



**Full\-Time Opportunity** 


 Candidates who perform well during the internship may have an opportunity to continue with Karagrey Media in a
 
**full\-time role after completing the minimum 3\-month internship.** 



**Who Will Thrive in This Role?** 


 This role is a strong fit for someone who genuinely enjoys
 
**people, recruitment, coordination, organization, and completion** 

 .
 





 HR at a growing company involves more than talking to candidates. It requires someone who can:
 




**Find the right people.** 




**Follow up consistently.**

description:
**Locations**: Gurgaon \| Mumbai


Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do

* The incumbent will identify the developmental needs, design, create and execute solutions across the organization at every level
* This person will also be involved in the content development, and responsible for bringing innovation and innovative trainings formats especially leveraging GenAI
* Responsible to create a culture of learning for continuous improvement in people as well as processes
* Responsible for setting clear points of evaluation and able to demonstrate the degree of success achieved for all L\&D interventions
* Ensuring that every L\&D intervention has clear business focused aims that enable robust evaluation of the event’s effectiveness, and measurement of return on investment
* To contribute to L\&D communications using a variety of mediums i.e mail, etc
* Identifying trainings needs and designing high impact agendas across a range of programs, including New Hire Orientation program, on\-going trainings to support performance, role readiness training programs, etc
* Collaborating with a range of stakeholders to both design programs and also execute them, often balancing competing stakeholder priorities
* Content creation with support from SMEs
* Managing a small team of 1\-2 members, to operationalize training days/ L\&D programs while driving impact at a strategic level
* External Vendor / Contracting: Select and assign instructors or vendors to conduct training Revisiting the current structure, content and delivery of modules,
* Market benchmarking, recording feedback for current trainers
* Training communication and branding: Publish Calendar on agreed timelines, Communication \- Creating awareness of the impact of several initiatives, Working with team members, partners, and key stakeholders to design meaningful learning experiences that meet audience needs, using key metrics (both qualitative and quantitative) to continuously evaluate learning initiatives and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Learning \& Development analytics \& reporting: Tracking and maintaining learning database , Attendance monitoring , Identifying suitable dates in line with global, regional and local event calendar, Update records for all employees on a real time basis \- event creation and registration (a month in advance), event participation, facilitator contribution and feedback score, training recommendations from CDC and reminders, etc, Provide MIS as required from time to time , Supporting regional and global teams for logistics for trainings in India. Also provide information required for India offices, Maintaining records of all invoices raised (training events, external trainers etc) , Monitor and evaluate training programs to ensure they are current and effective

  

What You'll Bring

* 8\-12 years of experience into Learning and development
* 5\-6 years of core experience in content development for trainings
* Mature and able to hold conversation with senior stakeholders
* An MBA or equivalent degree in HR

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 As the HR Manager, you will lead the entire employee lifecycle for our manufacturing unit. Supporting a workforce of 300\+ employees (including staff and shop floor teams), you will align HR operations with company business goals:

 YOUR OPPORTUNITY
   

  

 As Manager – India Supply HR Business Partner, you will be a key partner to the India Supply Chain Leadership Team, responsible for driving and executing the people agenda across Supply Chain operations in India. You will partner closely with Supply Chain leaders and people managers to build a high\-performing, engaged and future\-fit organization, translating the AMEA \& GTR Supply Chain People Strategy into meaningful actions and outcomes for India. The role will provide end\-to\-end HR partnership across Talent, Culture, Leadership, Capability, Organizational Effectiveness, Employee Relations and People Practices, while ensuring strong HR fundamentals, governance and compliance. **About You**
 You bring strong HR Business Partnering experience, preferably within Supply Chain, Manufacturing or Operations, with the ability to partner effectively with leaders and employees across levels. You combine a strong understanding of the business with practical HR expertise to translate people priorities into action.
   

  

 You have experience across talent management, performance, employee engagement, capability building, organizational effectiveness and employee relations. You are comfortable working in a dynamic and matrixed environment, building trusted relationships, coaching leaders and driving consistent execution of the people agenda.

 As HR Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the supply chain across INDIA business. In this position, you will:

 recruitment cost targets.

- 

**Capabilities:**
* Support the business in delivery of relevant and targeted training and development for Supply Chain teams with a focus on building awareness and capability across the People Strategy.

**People Practices and Systems**

* Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour requirements and partner with specialist HR teams and Legal where appropriate.

**Employee Relations \& Plant HR:**

* Proactively manage employee relations matters, grievances and workplace issues with consistency, fairness and speed.
* Partner with plant leadership on labour relations and, where applicable, worker\-management processes.
* Conduct or support objective investigations and partner with Legal and other stakeholders where required.


**Line Management:**
* Direct leadership and development for local Operations HR function and direct report based in India.


 INDIA Supply Chain has 100\+ employees, based across multiple locations. While the role is based in Gurgaon\-HO, you will need to travel to stay connected to all stakeholders in the markets.
   

  

**SKILLS** 
**\-** 
 THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE NEEDED TO CREATE YOUR LEGACLY
   

  

* Action orientated, delivering results whilst also ensuring the ‘fundamentals” are always covered.
* Knowledge, understanding and experience of full scope of Human Resources function
* Stakeholder and matrix management and engagement
* Curiosity and agility to adapt to changing context and enhance the HR offerings to teams
* Leader and coach who can support individuals and teams to deliver high performance.
* Engages and communicates well with all levels and inspires confidence in their decisions and approach


**PERSONAL QUALITIES** 
 – SHARE OUR FOUNDER’S PASSION AND ENTREPRENEURIAL FLAIR
   

  

* Consistency, pragmatism and fairness
* Does the right thing, is a natural coach and recognises / gives gratitude as a habit.
* Interpersonal skills – builds and maintains strong relationships, even when there is not always agreement
* Ability to influence, motivate and support HR programs across the business
* Strong relationship builder in complex organizational contexts, able to lead initiatives that will build a stronger Global Supply Chain function, closely aligned to the Regional needs.
* Building and motivating teams and individuals
* Drive for results
* Conflict resolution
* A self\-starter, who works well with autonomy.
* Handles ambiguity with comfort.
* Able to energize / inspire stakeholders around a clear vision of the future.
* Good negotiation, communication skills within area, backed up by proactive, decisive and entrepreneurial operating style
* Outstanding demonstrated leadership skills to operate successfully within the organizational matrix
* Builds high performing teams, developing direct reports and others to achieve superior performance
* Strong drive for results with positive, transparent and ethical leadership style
* Is non\-bureaucratic, listens and people\-oriented
* Is self\-confident with a “can do” attitude


 LEADERSHIP AGILITY
   

  

 At Bacardi we care deeply about finding brilliant talent who can bring the following personal attributes to help elevate our 3Fs: Fearless, Family, Founder culture to the next level.

description:
**Location** 
 : Hyderabad
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| Work from Office
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an HR Operations Manager to own day\-to\-day HR operations and statutory compliance administration across a distributed, multi\-jurisdiction team.
   

  

 This is a written\-first role by design. You'll be working across a distributed team with thin day\-to\-day supervision, translating direction into clear, actionable guidance for others — independently, not through live walkthroughs. If you do your best work in writing rather than in meetings, this role is built for that.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* HR operations \& compliance — Statutory compliance across multiple pay\-cycle jurisdictions, payroll execution, and keeping employee records and personal data handled appropriately. Resolving employee conflicts and compliance\-adjacent people issues.
* HR systems — Day\-to\-day configuration and administration of our HRMS platform, including making system changes to support process improvement — not just operating it as built.
* Performance cycle management — Running our KPI\-based performance review cycle end to end: chasing deadlines, checking review quality, following up with reviewers and reviewees, and feeding insights into how the next cycle's KPIs are shaped. Supporting defined employee retention activities, including identifying recurring people concerns and coordinating appropriate follow\-up with leadership.
* Talent \& succession support — Supporting leadership on talent and succession planning, and coordinating on resulting roles. Once a candidate is finalised through our hiring pipeline, you'll take over offer issuance, compensation negotiation, and onboarding, and can step in to cover the pipeline during short absences or transitions.
* Culture \& engagement — Coordinating with local leads so they can drive culture and engagement across our distributed offices.
* Learning \& development — Making sure employees complete their L\&D goals.


**What This Role Doesn't Own**
* Strategic HR direction and firm\-wide people policy sit above this seat.
* Candidate sourcing, screening, and interview scoring through to shortlist stay with our Talent Acquisition function — this role picks up from final selection onward (offer, onboarding, offboarding).
* Day\-to\-day performance management for individual teams stays with local leads — this seat runs the firm\-wide review cycle mechanics, not individual targets.


**What We're Looking For**
 Must\-have:
   

  

* Demonstrated experience across core HR functions — compliance, payroll, performance management, employee lifecycle, HR systems.
* Demonstrated experience working in a distributed, asynchronous, written\-first team, operating effectively without live, real\-time supervision.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern HRMS platform, with the ability to configure and adapt it to support process improvement, not just use it as built.


 Strongly preferred:
   

  

* Background in HR compliance or statutory administration spanning more than one jurisdiction or pay\-cycle regime.
* Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-volume operating environment.
* Prior exposure to running or supporting a structured KPI\-based performance review cycle.
* Comfortable navigating both peer\-level and wider employee conflicts — someone who listens well, acknowledges what people are feeling, and can still land on the call that's best for the firm.

 At SIS India, we take pride in our collaborative and empowering work environment. We encourage associates to not just build software, but also share ideas that, in the end, make a difference for the clients using it.
 



  





 The support doesn’t stop there – we also encourage professional growth and development, offering the ability to advance and/or transition throughout the organization depending on your career interests.
 



  





 The Senior Manager, Human Resources is a strategic and hands\-on HR leader for the Company’s onsite Noida workforce. Reporting to the Chief People Officer who is US\-based, this role oversees the employee life cycle, employee relations, manager support, performance, engagement, HR operations, and compliance for a growing healthcare IT and revenue cycle management organization. Success requires strong knowledge of India employment requirements, exceptional English communication skills, proven ability working in a fast\-paced, growing environment, and the ability to partner effectively across cultures and time zones.
 



  





 ESSENTIAL DUTIES/ RESPONSIBILITIES:
 


* Lead onsite HR operations and the employee life cycle for the Noida workforce, including onboarding, employee records, engagement, performance support, internal movement, employee relations, and separations.
* Advise managers and employees on employee relations matters, including coaching, conflict resolution, investigations, disciplinary action, performance improvement, and respectful workplace concerns.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer and global People leadership to scale HR programs, policies, processes, and manager support as the organization grows.
* Support workforce needs across healthcare IT, revenue cycle management, technology, and operational teams, including attendance, scheduling, productivity, quality, training, staffing, and retention.
* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable India employment requirements, including statutory benefits, leave, working hours, Shops and Establishments obligations, POSH, documentation, and record retention.
* Maintain accurate employee records, handbooks, policies, standard operating procedures, statutory documentation, and audit materials in partnership with Legal and Compliance.
* Prepare and analyze HR metrics related to headcount, attrition, engagement, employee relations, onboarding, compliance, and workforce planning.
* Use HR technology and responsibly governed AI tools to improve employee support, onboarding, case management, policy access, reporting, and manager self\-service while protecting privacy and confidentiality.
* Communicate effectively with India\- and U.S.\-based employees, managers, and executives across cultures, time zones, and business contexts.
* Stay current on relevant employment requirements, HR technology, and global people practices.
* Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time, subject to applicable law.



  





 EDUCATION REQUIRED:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required.



 SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS REQUIRED:
 


* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience in HR management, HR business partnership, employee relations, HR operations, or compliance.
* Strong knowledge of India employment practices and Noida requirements, including statutory benefits, leave, working hours, Shops and Establishments obligations, POSH, and employment records.
* Experience supporting onsite operational, hourly, entry\-level, or technology\-enabled employee populations in a growing organization.

title: Global People Support - Team Lead
description:
**About The Job**
 Who are we?
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. Stripe’s People \& Places Operations team will sit within the SDC and is a highly collaborative, cross\-functional team that drives key support for the People and Places function. We work with many different teams at Stripe. We are nimble and flexible individuals that can wear many different hats. We don’t mind working through ambiguity and love adding organization to chaos. We believe that success is not defined by any one individual, but rather by the collective work of the entire team.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide strategic HR leadership to HR Operations. Effectively manage, develop and engage the global team
* Ensure an exceptional employee experience by simplifying key processes
* Lead and implement HR initiatives and projects which are aligned within HR and Centers of Expertise (COE)
* Coordinate and lead key projects for improvement across HR
* Identify best practices that can be applied to improve work tasks and processes
* Deliver service improvement activity across HR through employing process improvement methodologies and the application of innovative thinking
* Promote and lead change
* Supports the administration and maintenance of HR systems while driving process and data integrity across the HR landscape
* Participate in and/or lead projects aimed at expanding centralization, leverage technology to improve the employee experience, and discover actionable insights and recommend solutions
* Responsible for driving process consistency, data integrity and compliance to HR policies, procedures, data privacy, audit controls and regulatory requirements in all HR Service Center activities
* Serves as the escalation point for HR Operations guiding the root cause analysis, resolution and communication protocol
* Manage the case management system (Ops ticketing system) and team to establish service level agreements
* Partner with the HRIS team supporting HR technology upgrades
* Develop and maintain team standard operating procedures
* Oversees relevant employee data management to ensure that data is secure and maintained consistent with company policies and privacy regulations and that required reporting and filings are delivered
* Track HR metrics to identify areas for improvement. Develop and implement counter\-measures to correct identified misses to goals


**Skills**
* Proficiency in verbal \& written communication in English
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
* Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
* Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
* Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Minimum 5\+ years of people and operations management experience
* Education \- Grad/Post Grad in human resources or a related discipline
* Desired 8\+ years of experience in People Operations
* Experience with HR systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Confluence and Salesforce
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision
* Excellent leadership skills, data analytical \& presentation skills, written \& Communication skills
* Understanding of overall HR lifecycle – Core HR, Benefits, Talent Mobility, Equity, Compensation, Exits, etc.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

 With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting\-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. We are headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden with more than 55 offices worldwide.
   

  

 We are a fast\-evolving global organisation backed by a leading private equity firm, Antin Infrastructure Partners, continuing an ambitious journey of expansion and transformation. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent, the key drivers that will take us to the next level. A truly exciting time to join us.
   

  

 As part of our Global HR team, you will play a key role in enabling our organisation through high\-quality HR processes, reliable people data, and effective digital HR solutions. If you enjoy working at the intersection of HR administration, systems, analytics, process improvement, and stakeholder support, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, international environment.

**Your Role: Driving Global HR Operations \& Data Excellence**
 As HR Coordinator, you will be part of our global HR function, supporting managers, employees, and HR colleagues across the organisation. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring high\-quality HR data and supporting our global HR systems, enabling our business to make informed decisions based on reliable people data.
   

  

 You will act as one of the first points of contact for HR system\-related questions, helping users navigate our digital HR landscape while continuously improving processes and ways of working. You will also work proactively to monitor data quality, identify inconsistencies, and collaborate with local HR teams and system administrators to ensure our global HR information remains accurate and up to date.
   

  

 As our HR function continues to evolve, you will have the opportunity to actively contribute to process improvements, digitalisation initiatives, and the implementation of new ways of working.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 As HR Coordinator, you will:
   

  

* Maintain high\-quality employee data across our global HR systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
